verses.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
verses.fr: Après la mort de Josué, les enfants d''Israël consultèrent l''Eternel, en disant: Qui de nous montera le premier contre les Cananéens, pour les attaquer?
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ኢያሱ ከሞተ በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች። ከነዓናውያንን ለመውጋት ማን በፊት ይወጣልናል? ብለው እግዚአብሔርን ጠየቁ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit: Juda montera, voici, j''ai livré le pays entre ses mains.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ይሁዳ ይውጣ፤ እነሆ፥ ምድሪቱን በእጁ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
verses.fr: Et Juda dit à Siméon, son frère: Monte avec moi dans le pays qui m''est échu par le sort, et nous combattrons les Cananéens; j''irai aussi avec toi dans celui qui t''est tombé en partage. Et Siméon alla avec lui.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ወንድሙን ስምዖንን። ከነዓናውያንን እንወጋ ዘንድ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ዕጣዬ ውጣ፥ እኔም ደግሞ ከአንተ ጋር ወደ ዕጣህ እሄዳለሁ አለው። ስምዖንም ከእርሱ ጋር ሄደ።

verses.en: And Judah went up; and the Lord delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
verses.fr: Juda monta, et l''Eternel livra entre leurs mains les Cananéens et les Phéréziens; ils battirent dix mille hommes à Bézek.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ወጣ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንን በእጃቸው አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ ከእነርሱም በቤዜቅ ውስጥ አሥር ሺህ ሰዎች ገደሉ።

verses.en: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.fr: Ils trouvèrent Adoni-Bézek à Bézek; ils l''attaquèrent, et ils battirent les Cananéens et les Phéréziens.
verses.am: አዶኒቤዜቅንም በቤዜቅ አገኙትና ተዋጉት፤ ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንንም መቱአቸው።

verses.en: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
verses.fr: Adoni-Bézek prit la fuite; mais ils le poursuivirent et le saisirent, et ils lui coupèrent les pouces des mains et des pieds.
verses.am: አዶኒቤዜቅም ሸሸ፤ አሳድደውም ያዙት፥ የእጁንና የእግሩንም አውራ ጣት ቈረጡ።

verses.en: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
verses.fr: Adoni-Bézek dit: Soixante-dix rois, ayant les pouces des mains et des pieds coupés, ramassaient sous ma table; Dieu me rend ce que j''ai fait. On l''emmena à Jérusalem, et il y mourut.
verses.am: አዶኒቤዜቅም። የእጃቸውና የእግራቸው አውራ ጣት የተቈረጡ ሰባ ነገሥታት ከገበታዬ በታች ፍርፋሪ ይለቅሙ ነበር፤ እኔ እንዳደረግሁ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ መለሰልኝ አለ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም አመጡት፥ በዚያም ሞተ።

verses.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.fr: Les fils de Juda attaquèrent Jérusalem et la prirent, ils la frappèrent du tranchant de l''épée et mirent le feu à la ville.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ልጆች ኢየሩሳሌምን ተዋግተው ያዙአት፥ በሰይፍ ስለትም መቱአት፥ ከተማይቱንም በእሳት አቃጠሉአት።

verses.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
verses.fr: Les fils de Juda descendirent ensuite, pour combattre les Cananéens qui habitaient la montagne, la contrée du midi et la plaine.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የይሁዳ ልጆች በተራራማው አገርና በደቡቡ በኩል በቈላውም ውስጥ የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያንን ሊወጉ ወረዱ።

verses.en: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.fr: Juda marcha contre les Cananéens qui habitaient à Hébron, appelée autrefois Kirjath-Arba; et il battit Schéschaï, Ahiman et Talmaï.
verses.am: ይሁዳም በኬብሮን የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያንን ሊወጋ ሄደ። የኬብሮንም ስም አስቀድሞ ቂርያትአርባቅ ነበረ። ሴሲንና አኪመንን ተላሚንም ገደሉ።

verses.en: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:
verses.fr: De là il marcha contre les habitants de Debir: Debir s''appelait autrefois Kirjath-Sépher.
verses.am: ከዚያም የዳቤርን ሰዎች ሊወጋ ሄደ፤ አስቀድሞም የዳቤር ስም ቅርያትሤፍር ነበረ።

verses.en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.fr: Caleb dit: Je donnerai ma fille Acsa pour femme à celui qui battra Kirjath-Sépher et qui la prendra.
verses.am: ካሌብም። ቅርያትሤፍርን ለሚመታና ለሚይዝ ልጄን ዓክሳን አጋባዋለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.fr: Othniel, fils de Kenaz, frère cadet de Caleb, s''en empara; et Caleb lui donna pour femme sa fille Acsa.
verses.am: የካሌብም ትንሽ ወንድም የቄኔዝ ልጅ ጎቶንያል ያዛት፤ ልጁንም ዓክሳን አጋባው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
verses.fr: Lorsqu''elle fut entrée chez Othniel, elle le sollicita de demander à son père un champ. Elle descendit de dessus son âne; et Caleb lui dit: Qu''as-tu?
verses.am: እርስዋም ወደ እርሱ በመጣች ጊዜ ከአባትዋ እርሻ እንዲለምን መከረችው። እርስዋም ከአህያዋ ወረደች፤ ካሌብም። ምን ፈለግሽ? አላት።

verses.en: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
verses.fr: Elle lui répondit: Fais-moi un présent, car tu m''as donné une terre du midi; donne-moi aussi des sources d''eau. Et Caleb lui donna les sources supérieures et les sources inférieures.
verses.am: እርስዋም። በረከትን ስጠኝ፤ በደቡብ በኩል ያለውን ምድር ሰጥተኸኛልና የውኃ ምንጭ ደግሞ ስጠኝ አለችው። ካሌብም ላይኛውንና ታችኛውን ምንጭ ሰጣት።

verses.en: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
verses.fr: Les fils du Kénien, beau-père de Moïse, montèrent de la ville des palmiers, avec les fils de Juda, dans le désert de Juda au midi d''Arad, et ils allèrent s''établir parmi le peuple.
verses.am: የቄናዊው የሙሴ አማት ልጆችም ከይሁዳ ልጆች ጋር ዘንባባ ካለባት ከተማ ተነሥተው ከዓራድ በደቡብ በኩል ወዳለው ወደ ይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ ሄደውም ከሕዝቡ ጋር ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.fr: Juda se mit en marche avec Siméon, son frère, et ils battirent les Cananéens qui habitaient à Tsephath; ils dévouèrent la ville par interdit, et on l''appela Horma.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ከወንድሙ ከስምዖን ጋር ሄደ፥ በጽፋት የተቀመጡትንም ከነዓናውያንን መቱ፥ ፈጽመውም አጠፉአት። የከተማይቱንም ስም ሔርማ ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.en: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
verses.fr: Juda s''empara encore de Gaza et de son territoire, d''Askalon et de son territoire, et d''Ekron et de son territoire.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ጋዛንና ዳርቻዋን፥ አስቀሎናንና ዳርቻዋን፥ አቃሮንንና ዳርቻዋን ያዘ።

verses.en: And the Lord was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fut avec Juda; et Juda se rendit maître de la montagne, mais il ne put chasser les habitants de la plaine, parce qu''ils avaient des chars de fer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከይሁዳ ጋር ነበረ፤ ይሁዳም ተራራማውን አገር ወረሰ፤ በሸለቆው የሚኖሩት ግን የብረት ሰረገሎች ነበሩአቸውና ሊያወጣቸው አልቻለም።

verses.en: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
verses.fr: On donna Hébron à Caleb, comme l''avait dit Moïse; et il en chassa les trois fils d''Anak.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደ ተናገረ ለካሌብ ኬብሮንን ሰጡት፤ ከዚያም ሦስቱን የዔናቅ ልጆች አወጣ።

verses.en: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.fr: Les fils de Benjamin ne chassèrent point les Jébusiens qui habitaient à Jérusalem; et les Jébusiens ont habité jusqu''à ce jour dans Jérusalem avec les fils de Benjamin.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን ኢያቡሳውያንን የብንያም ልጆች አላወጡአቸውም፤ ኢያቡሳውያንም ከብንያም ልጆች ጋር እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.en: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the Lord was with them.
verses.fr: La maison de Joseph monta aussi contre Béthel, et l''Eternel fut avec eux.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ወገን ደግሞ በቤቴል ላይ ወጡ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
verses.fr: La maison de Joseph fit explorer Béthel, qui s''appelait autrefois Luz.
verses.am: የዮሴፍም ወገን ቤቴልን የሚሰልሉ ላኩ። አስቀድሞም የከተማይቱ ስም ሎዛ ይባል ነበር።

verses.en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
verses.fr: Les gardes virent un homme qui sortait de la ville, et ils lui dirent: Montre-nous par où nous pourrons entrer dans la ville, et nous te ferons grâce.
verses.am: ጠባቂዎቹም አንድ ሰው ከከተማ ሲወጣ አይተው። የከተማይቱን መግቢያ አሳየን፥ እኛም ቸርነት እናደርግልሃለን አሉት።

verses.en: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
verses.fr: Il leur montra par où ils pourraient entrer dans la ville. Et ils frappèrent la ville du tranchant de l''épée; mais ils laissèrent aller cet homme et toute sa famille.
verses.am: የከተማይቱንም መግቢያ አሳያቸው፥ ከተማይቱንም በሰይፍ ስለት መቱ፤ ያንን ሰውና ወገኖቹን ግን ለቀቁአቸው።

verses.en: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
verses.fr: Cet homme se rendit dans le pays des Héthiens; il bâtit une ville, et lui donna le nom de Luz, nom qu''elle a porté jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ሰውየውም ወደ ኬጢያውያን ምድር ሄደ፥ በዚያም ከተማን ሠራ፥ ስምዋንም ሎዛ ብሎ ጠራት። እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ስምዋ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.fr: Manassé ne chassa point les habitants de Beth-Schean et des villes de son ressort, de Thaanac et des villes de son ressort, de Dor et des villes de son ressort, de Jibleam et des villes de son ressort, de Meguiddo et des villes de son ressort; et les Cananéens voulurent rester dans ce pays.
verses.am: ምናሴም የቤትሳንንና የመንደሮችዋን፥ የታዕናክንና የመንደሮችዋን፥ የዶርንና የመንደሮችዋን፥ የይብለዓምንና የመንደሮችዋን፥ የመጊዶንና የመንደሮችዋን ሰዎች አላወጣቸውም፤ ነገር ግን ከነዓናውያን በዚያ አገር በመቀመጥ ጸኑ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''Israël fut assez fort, il assujettit les Cananéens à un tribut, mais il ne les chassa point.
verses.am: እስራኤልም በበረቱ ጊዜ ከነዓናውያንን አስገበሩአቸው፥ ፈጽመውም አላወጡአቸውም።

verses.en: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
verses.fr: Ephraïm ne chassa point les Cananéens qui habitaient à Guézer, et les Cananéens habitèrent au milieu d''Ephraïm à Guézer.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምም በጌዝር የተቀመጡትን ከነዓናውያንን አላወጣቸውም፤ ነገር ግን ከነዓናውያን በመካከላቸው በጌዝር ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
verses.fr: Zabulon ne chassa point les habitants de Kitron, ni les habitants de Nahalol; et les Cananéens habitèrent au milieu de Zabulon, mais ils furent assujettis à un tribut.
verses.am: ዛብሎንም የቂድሮንንና የነህሎልን ሰዎች አላወጣቸውም፤ ነገር ግን ከነዓናውያን በመካከላቸው ተቀመጡ፥ ግብርም የሚገብሩለት ሆኑ።

verses.en: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
verses.fr: Aser ne chassa point les habitants d''Acco, ni les habitants de Sidon, ni ceux d''Achlal, d''Aczib, de Helba, d''Aphik et de Rehob;
verses.am: አሴርም የዓኮንና የሲዶንን የአሕላብንም የአክዚብንም የሒልባንም የአፌቅንም የረአብንም ሰዎች አላወጣቸውም።

verses.en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
verses.fr: et les Asérites habitèrent au milieu des Cananéens, habitants du pays, car ils ne les chassèrent point.
verses.am: በዚያችም ምድር የተቀመጡትን ከነዓናውያን አላወጡአቸውምና በመካከላቸው የአሴር ልጆች ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
verses.fr: Nephthali ne chassa point les habitants de Beth-Schémesch, ni les habitants de Beth-Anath, et il habita au milieu des Cananéens, habitants du pays, mais les habitants de Beth-Schémesch et de Beth-Anath furent assujettis à un tribut.
verses.am: ንፍታሌምም የቤትሳሚስንና የቤትዓናትን ሰዎች አላወጣቸውም፥ በምድሩም በተቀመጡት በከነዓናውያን መካከል ተቀመጡ፤ ነገር ግን የቤትሳሚስና የቤትዓናት ሰዎች ግብር የሚገብሩለት ሆኑ።

verses.en: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
verses.fr: Les Amoréens repoussèrent dans la montagne les fils de Dan, et ne les laissèrent pas descendre dans la plaine.
verses.am: አሞራውያንም የዳንን ልጆች ወደ ተራራማው አገር እንዲያፈገፍጉ አስገደዱአቸው፥ ወደ ሸለቆውም እንዳይወርዱ ከለከሉአቸው።

verses.en: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
verses.fr: Les Amoréens voulurent rester à Har- Hérès, à Ajalon et à Schaalbim; mais la main de la maison de Joseph s''appesantit sur eux, et ils furent assujettis à un tribut.
verses.am: አሞራውያን በሔሬስ ተራራና በኤሎን በሸዓልቢምም በመቀመጥ ጸኑ፤ ነገር ግን የዮሴፍ ቤት እጅ ከበደች፥ አስገበረቻቸውም።

verses.en: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.fr: Le territoire des Amoréens s''étendait depuis la montée d''Akrabbim, depuis Séla, et en dessus.
verses.am: የአሞራውያንም ድንበር ከአቅረቢም ዐቀበት ከጭንጫው ጀምሮ እስከ ላይ ድረስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And an angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
verses.fr: Un envoyé de l''Eternel monta de Guilgal à Bokim, et dit: Je vous ai fait monter hors d''Egypte, et je vous ai amenés dans le pays que j''ai juré à vos pères de vous donner. J''ai dit: Jamais je ne romprai mon alliance avec vous;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ከጌልገላ ወደ ቦኪም ወጥቶ እንዲህ አለ። እኔ ከግብፅ አውጥቻችኋለሁ፥ ለአባቶቻችሁም ወደ ማልሁላቸው ምድር አግብቻችኋለሁ፤ እኔም። ከእናንተ ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን ለዘላለም አላፈርስም፤

verses.en: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
verses.fr: et vous, vous ne traiterez point alliance avec les habitants de ce pays, vous renverserez leurs autels. Mais vous n''avez point obéi à ma voix. Pourquoi avez-vous fait cela?
verses.am: እናንተም መሠዊያቸውን አፍርሱ እንጂ በዚህች ምድር ከሚኖሩ ሰዎች ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አታድርጉ አልሁ። እናንተ ግን ቃሌን አልሰማችሁም፤

verses.en: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
verses.fr: J''ai dit alors: Je ne les chasserai point devant vous; mais ils seront à vos côtés, et leurs dieux vous seront un piège.
verses.am: ይህንስ ለምን አደረጋችሁ? ስለዚህም። ከፊታችሁ አላወጣቸውም፥ ነገር ግን ያስጨንቋችኋል፥ አማልክቶቻቸውም ወጥመድ ይሆኑባችኋል አልሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the angel of the Lord spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''envoyé de l''Eternel eut dit ces paroles à tous les enfants d''Israël, le peuple éleva la voix et pleura.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ይህን ቃል ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በተናገረ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ድምፃቸውን አንሥተው አለቀሱ።

verses.en: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils donnèrent à ce lieu le nom de Bokim, et ils y offrirent des sacrifices à l''Eternel.
verses.am: የዚያንም ስፍራ ስም ቦኪም ብለው ጠሩት፤ በዚያም ለእግዚአብሔር ሠዉ።

verses.en: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.fr: Josué renvoya le peuple, et les enfants d''Israël allèrent chacun dans son héritage pour prendre possession du pays.
verses.am: ኢያሱም ሕዝቡን ባሰናበተ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ምድሪቱን ሊወርሱ ወደ እየርስታቸው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the Lord, that he did for Israel.
verses.fr: Le peuple servit l''Eternel pendant toute la vie de Josué, et pendant toute la vie des anciens qui survécurent à Josué et qui avaient vu toutes les grandes choses que l''Eternel avait faites en faveur d''Israël.
verses.am: ኢያሱም በነበረበት ዘመን ሁሉ፥ ለእስራኤልም ያደረገውን ታላቁን የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ ሁሉ ባዩት፥ ከኢያሱ በኋላ በነበሩ ሽማግሌዎች ዘመን ሁሉ፥ ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔርን አመለኩ።

verses.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.fr: Josué, fils de Nun, serviteur de l''Eternel, mourut âgé de cent dix ans.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ ዕድሜው መቶ አሥር ዓመት ሲሆነው ሞተ።

verses.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
verses.fr: On l''ensevelit dans le territoire qu''il avait eu en partage, à Thimnath-Hérès, dans la montagne d''Ephraïm, au nord de la montagne de Gaasch.
verses.am: በተራራማውም በኤፍሬም አገር በገዓስ ተራራ በሰሜን ባለችው በርስቱ ዳርቻ በተምናሔሬስ ቀበሩት።

verses.en: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the Lord, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.
verses.fr: Toute cette génération fut recueillie auprès de ses pères, et il s''éleva après elle une autre génération, qui ne connaissait point l''Eternel, ni ce qu''il avait fait en faveur d''Israël.
verses.am: ትውልድ ሁሉ ደግሞ ወደ አባቶቻቸው ተከማቹ፤ ከእነዚያም በኋላ እግዚአብሔርን ለእስራኤልም ያደረገውን ሥራ ያላወቀ ሌላ ትውልድ ተነሣ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim:
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent alors ce qui déplaît à l''Eternel, et ils servirent les Baals.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ የሆነ ነገር አደረጉ፥ በኣሊምንም አመለኩ።

verses.en: And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the Lord to anger.
verses.fr: Ils abandonnèrent l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères, qui les avait fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, et ils allèrent après d''autres dieux d''entre les dieux des peuples qui les entouraient; ils se prosternèrent devant eux, et ils irritèrent l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከግብፅ ምድርም ያወጣቸውን የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ተዉ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ካሉት ከአሕዛብ አማልክት ሌሎችን አማልክት ተከተሉ፥ ሰገዱላቸውም፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አስቈጡ።

verses.en: And they forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
verses.fr: Ils abandonnèrent l''Eternel, et ils servirent Baal et les Astartés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ትተው በኣልንና አስታሮትን አመለኩ።

verses.en: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Israël. Il les livra entre les mains de pillards qui les pillèrent, il les vendit entre les mains de leurs ennemis d''alentour, et ils ne purent plus résister à leurs ennemis.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ ወደ ማረኩአቸውም ማራኪዎች እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ በዙሪያቸውም ባሉት በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥ ጠላቶቻቸውንም ከዚያ ወዲያ ሊቋቋሙ አልቻሉም።

verses.en: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord had said, and as the Lord had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
verses.fr: Partout où ils allaient, la main de l''Eternel était contre eux pour leur faire du mal, comme l''Eternel l''avait dit, comme l''Eternel le leur avait juré. Ils furent ainsi dans une grande détresse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ እንደማለ፥ ወደ ወጡበት ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ትከፋባቸው ነበረች፤ እጅግም ተጨነቁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless the Lord raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
verses.fr: L''Eternel suscita des juges, afin qu''ils les délivrassent de la main de ceux qui les pillaient.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መሳፍንትን አስነሣላቸው፥ ከሚማርኩአቸውም እጅ አዳኑአቸው።

verses.en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the Lord; but they did not so.
verses.fr: Mais ils n''écoutèrent pas même leurs juges, car ils se prostituèrent à d''autres dieux, se prosternèrent devant eux. Ils se détournèrent promptement de la voie qu''avaient suivie leurs pères, et ils n''obéirent point comme eux aux commandements de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሌሎች አማልክትን ተከትለው አመነዘሩ ሰገዱላቸውም እንጂ መሳፍንቶቻቸውን አልሰሙም፤ አባቶቻቸውም ይሄዱበት ከነበረ መንገድ ፈጥነው ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ አባቶቻቸው ለእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ እንደ ታዘዙ እንዲሁ አላደረጉም።

verses.en: And when the Lord raised them up judges, then the Lord was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the Lord because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''Eternel leur suscitait des juges, l''Eternel était avec le juge, et il les délivrait de la main de leurs ennemis pendant toute la vie du juge; car l''Eternel avait pitié de leurs gémissements contre ceux qui les opprimaient et les tourmentaient.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መሳፍንትን ባስነሣላቸው ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከመስፍኑ ጋር ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ስለሚጋፉአቸውና ስለሚያስጨንቋቸው በጩኸታቸው ያዝን ነበርና በመስፍኑ ዘመን ሁሉ ከጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አዳናቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
verses.fr: Mais, à la mort du juge, ils se corrompaient de nouveau plus que leurs pères, en allant après d''autres dieux pour les servir et se prosterner devant eux, et ils persévéraient dans la même conduite et le même endurcissement.
verses.am: መስፍኑ ግን ከሞተ በኋላ ይመለሱ ነበር፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት በመከተላቸው እነርሱንም በማምለካቸውና ለእነርሱ በመስገዳቸው አባቶቻቸው አድርገውት ከነበረው የከፋ ያደርጉ ነበር፤ የእልከኝነታቸውን መንገድና ሥራቸውን አልተዉም ነበር።

verses.en: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
verses.fr: Alors la colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Israël, et il dit: Puisque cette nation a transgressé mon alliance que j''avais prescrite à ses pères, et puisqu''ils n''ont point obéi à ma voix,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ እንዲህም አለ። ይህ ሕዝብ ለአባቶቻቸው ያዘዝሁትን ቃል ኪዳን ስለ ተላለፉ፥ ድምፄንም ስላልሰሙ አባቶቻቸውም እንደ ጠበቁ፥

verses.en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
verses.fr: je ne chasserai plus devant eux aucune des nations que Josué laissa quand il mourut.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እነዚህን አሕዛብ አስቀረ፥ ፈጥኖም አላወጣቸውም፥ በኢያሱም እጅ አሳልፎ አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.en: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the Lord to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que je mettrai par elles Israël à l''épreuve, pour savoir s''ils prendront garde ou non de suivre la voie de l''Eternel, comme leurs pères y ont pris garde.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እነዚህን አሕዛብ አስቀረ፥ ፈጥኖም አላወጣቸውም፥ በኢያሱም እጅ አሳልፎ አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.en: Therefore the Lord left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel laissa en repos ces nations qu''il n''avait pas livrées entre les mains de Josué, et il ne se hâta point de les chasser.
verses.am: ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እነዚህን አሕዛብ አስቀረ፥ ፈጥኖም አላወጣቸውም፥ በኢያሱም እጅ አሳልፎ አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.en: Now these are the nations which the Lord left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
verses.fr: Voici les nations que l''Eternel laissa pour éprouver par elles Israël, tous ceux qui n''avaient pas connu toutes les guerres de Canaan.
verses.am: ከከነዓናውያንም ጋር መዋጋት ያላወቁትን እስራኤልን በእነርሱ፤

verses.en: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
verses.fr: Il voulait seulement que les générations des enfants d''Israël connussent et apprissent la guerre, ceux qui ne l''avaient pas connue auparavant.
verses.am: ይፈትናቸው ዘንድ፥ በፊትም ሰልፍን ያልለመዱ የእስራኤል ልጆች ትውልድ መዋጋትን ያውቁና ይማሩ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያስቀራቸው አሕዛብ እነዚህ ናቸው፤

verses.en: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
verses.fr: Ces nations étaient: les cinq princes des Philistins, tous les Cananéens, les Sidoniens, et les Héviens qui habitaient la montagne du Liban, depuis la montagne de Baal-Hermon jusqu''à l''entrée de Hamath.
verses.am: አምስቱ የፍልስጥኤማውያን መኳንንት፥ ከነዓናውያንም ሁሉ፥ ሲዶናውያንም፥ ከበኣልአርሞንዔም ተራራ ጀምሮ እስከ ሐማት መግቢያ ድረስ በሊባኖስ ተራራ የሚኖሩትም ኤዊያውያን።

verses.en: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the Lord, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Ces nations servirent à mettre Israël à l''épreuve, afin que l''Eternel sût s''ils obéiraient aux commandements qu''il avait prescrits à leurs pères par Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ ለአባቶቻቸው ያዘዘውን ትእዛዝ መስማታቸው እንዲታወቅ እስራኤል ይፈተኑባቸው ዘንድ እነዚህ ቀሩ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
verses.fr: Et les enfants d''Israël habitèrent au milieu des Cananéens, des Héthiens, des Amoréens, des Phéréziens, des Héviens et des Jébusiens;
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከነዓናውያን በኬጢያውያንም በአሞራውያንም በፌርዛውያንም በኤዊያውያንም በኢያቡሳውያንም መካከል ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
verses.fr: ils prirent leurs filles pour femmes, ils donnèrent à leurs fils leurs propres filles, et ils servirent leurs dieux.
verses.am: ሴት ልጆቻቸውንም አገቡአቸው፥ እነርሱም ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ለወንዶች ልጆቻቸው ሰጡ፥ አማልክቶቻቸውንም አመለኩ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and forgat the Lord their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent ce qui déplaît à l''Eternel, ils oublièrent l''Eternel, et ils servirent les Baals et les idoles.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ የሆነውን ነገር አደረጉ፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ረስተው በኣሊምንና አስታሮትን አመለኩ።

verses.en: Therefore the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Israël, et il les vendit entre les mains de Cuschan-Rischeathaïm, roi de Mésopotamie. Et les enfants d''Israël furent asservis huit ans à Cuschan-Rischeathaïm.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ በመስጴጦምያ ንጉሥ በኵሰርሰቴም እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለኵሰርሰቴም ስምንት ዓመት ተገዙለት።

verses.en: And when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël crièrent à l''Eternel, et l''Eternel leur suscita un libérateur qui les délivra, Othniel, fils de Kenaz, frère cadet de Caleb.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሚያድናቸውን አዳኝ የካሌብን የታናሽ ወንድሙን የቄኔዝን ልጅ ጎቶንያልን አስነሣላቸው።

verses.en: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the Lord delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
verses.fr: L''esprit de l''Eternel fut sur lui. Il devint juge en Israël, et il partit pour la guerre. L''Eternel livra entre ses mains Cuschan-Rischeathaïm, roi de Mésopotamie, et sa main fut puissante contre Cuschan-Rischeathaïm.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በእርሱ ላይ መጣ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ይፈርድ ነበር፤ ለሰልፍ ወጣ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የመስጴጦምያን ንጉሥ ኵሰርሰቴምን በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ እጁም በኵሰርሰቴም ላይ አሸነፈች።

verses.en: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.fr: Le pays fut en repos pendant quarante ans. Et Othniel, fils de Kenaz, mourut.
verses.am: ምድሪቱም አርባ ዓመት ዐረፈች፤ የቄኔዝም ልጅ ጎቶንያል ሞተ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent encore ce qui déplaît à l''Eternel; et l''Eternel fortifia Eglon, roi de Moab, contre Israël, parce qu''ils avaient fait ce qui déplaît à l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ገና ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ስለ ሠሩ እግዚአብሔር የሞዓብን ንጉሥ ዔግሎምን በእስራኤል ላይ አበረታባቸው።

verses.en: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
verses.fr: Eglon réunit à lui les fils d''Ammon et les Amalécites, et il se mit en marche. Il battit Israël, et ils s''emparèrent de la ville des palmiers.
verses.am: የአሞንን ልጆችና አማሌቅን ወደ እርሱ ሰበሰበ፤ ሄዶም እስራኤልን መታ፥ ዘንባባም ያለባትን ከተማ ያዙአት።

verses.en: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.fr: Et les enfants d''Israël furent asservis dix-huit ans à Eglon, roi de Moab.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለሞዓብ ንጉሥ ለዔግሎም አሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ተገዙለት።

verses.en: But when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël crièrent à l''Eternel, et l''Eternel leur suscita un libérateur, Ehud, fils de Guéra, Benjamite, qui ne se servait pas de la main droite. Les enfants d''Israël envoyèrent par lui un présent à Eglon, roi de Moab.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ብንያማዊውን የጌራን ልጅ ናዖድን ግራኙን ሰው አዳኝ አስነሣላቸው፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእርሱ እጅ ወደ ሞዓብ ንጉሥ ወደ ዔግሎም ግብር ላኩ።

verses.en: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
verses.fr: Ehud se fit une épée à deux tranchants, longue d''une coudée, et il la ceignit sous ses vêtements, au côté droit.
verses.am: ናዖድም ሁለት አፍ ያለው ርዝመቱ አንድ ክንድ የሆነ ሰይፍ አበጀ፥ ከልብሱም በታች በቀኝ ጭኑ በኩል አደረገው።

verses.en: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
verses.fr: Il offrit le présent à Eglon, roi de Moab: or Eglon était un homme très gras.
verses.am: ለሞዓብም ንጉሥ ለዔግሎም ግብሩን አቀረበ፤ ዔግሎምም እጅግ ወፍራም ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il eut achevé d''offrir le présent, il renvoya les gens qui l''avaient apporté.
verses.am: ግብሩንም ማቅረብ በጨረሰ ጊዜ፥ ግብር የተሸከሙትን ሰዎች ሰደደ።

verses.en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
verses.fr: Il revint lui-même depuis les carrières près de Guilgal, et il dit: O roi! j''ai quelque chose de secret à te dire. Le roi dit: Silence! Et tous ceux qui étaient auprès de lui sortirent.
verses.am: ናዖድ ግን በጌልገላ ከነበሩት ትክል ድንጋዮች ዘንድ ተመልሶ። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ የምሥጢር ነገር አለኝ አለ፤ ንጉሡም። ዝም በል አለ፤ በዙሪያውም የቆሙት ሁሉ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.
verses.fr: Ehud l''aborda comme il était assis seul dans sa chambre d''été, et il dit: J''ai une parole de Dieu pour toi. Eglon se leva de son siège.
verses.am: ናዖድም ወደ እርሱ ቀረበ፤ እርሱም በሰገነት ቤት ለብቻው ተቀምጦ ነበር። ናዖድም። የእግዚአብሔር መልእክት ለአንተ አለኝ አለ። ከዙፋኑም ተነሣ።

verses.en: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
verses.fr: Alors Ehud avança la main gauche, tira l''épée de son côté droit, et la lui enfonça dans le ventre.
verses.am: ናዖድም ግራ እጁን ዘርግቶ ከቀኝ ጭኑ ሰይፉን ወሰደ፥ ሆዱንም ወጋው፤

verses.en: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
verses.fr: La poignée même entra après la lame, et la graisse se referma autour de la lame; car il ne retira pas du ventre l''épée, qui sortit par derrière.
verses.am: የሰይፉም እጀታው ደግሞ ከስለቱ በኋላ ገባ፤ ስቡም ስለቱን ከደነው፥ ሰይፉንም ከሆዱ መልሶ አላወጣውም፤ በኋላውም ወጣ።

verses.en: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
verses.fr: Ehud sortit par le portique, ferma sur lui les portes de la chambre haute, et tira le verrou.
verses.am: ናዖድም ወደ ደርቡ ወጣ፥ የሰገነቱንም ደጅ ዘግቶ ቈለፈው።

verses.en: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
verses.fr: Quand il fut sorti, les serviteurs du roi vinrent et regardèrent; et voici, les portes de la chambre haute étaient fermées au verrou. Ils dirent: Sans doute il se couvre les pieds dans la chambre d''été.
verses.am: ናዖድም ከሄደ በኋላ ባሪያዎቹ መጡ፤ የሰገነቱም ደጅ ተቈልፎ ባዩ ጊዜ። ምናልባት በሰገነቱ ውስጥ ወገቡን ይሞክር ይሆናል አሉ።

verses.en: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
verses.fr: Ils attendirent longtemps; et comme il n''ouvrait pas les portes de la chambre haute, ils prirent la clé et ouvrirent, et voici, leur maître était mort, étendu par terre.
verses.am: እስኪያፍሩም ድረስ እጅግ ዘገዩ፤ የሰገነቱንም ደጅ እንዳልከፈተ ባዩ ጊዜ መክፈቻውን ወስደው ከፈቱ፥ እነሆም፥ ጌታቸው በምድር ወድቆ ሞቶም አገኙት።

verses.en: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
verses.fr: Pendant leurs délais, Ehud prit la fuite, dépassa les carrières, et se sauva à Seïra.
verses.am: በዘገዩበትም ጊዜያት ናዖድ ሸሸ፥ ትክል ድንጋዮቹንም አለፈ፥ ወደ ቤይሮታም አመለጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
verses.fr: Dès qu''il fut arrivé, il sonna de la trompette dans la montagne d''Ephraïm. Les enfants d''Israël descendirent avec lui de la montagne, et il se mit à leur tête.
verses.am: በመጣም ጊዜ በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ቀንደ መለከት ነፋ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከእርሱ ጋር ከተራራማው አገር ወረዱ፥ እርሱም በፊታቸው ሄደ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the Lord hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Suivez-moi, car l''Eternel a livré entre vos mains les Moabites, vos ennemis. Ils descendirent après lui, s''emparèrent des gués du Jourdain vis-à-vis de Moab, et ne laissèrent passer personne.
verses.am: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር ጠላቶቻችሁን ሞዓባውያንን በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና ተከተሉኝ አላቸው። ተከትለውትም ወረዱ፥ ወደ ሞዓብም የሚያሻግረውን የዮርዳኖስን መሻገርያ ያዙ፥ ማንንም አላሳለፉም።

verses.en: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
verses.fr: Ils battirent dans ce temps-là environ dix mille hommes de Moab, tous robustes, tous vaillants, et pas un n''échappa.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜም ከሞዓብ አሥር ሺህ የሚያህሉትን፥ ጕልማሶችና ጽኑዓን ሁሉ፥ መቱ፤ አንድ እንኳ አላመለጠም።

verses.en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
verses.fr: En ce jour, Moab fut humilié sous la main d''Israël. Et le pays fut en repos pendant quatre-vingts ans.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሞዓብ ከእስራኤል እጅ በታች ተዋረደ፤ ምድሪቱም ሰማንያ ዓመት ዐረፈች።

verses.en: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
verses.fr: Après lui, il y eut Schamgar, fils d''Anath. Il battit six cents hommes des Philistins avec un aiguillon à boeufs. Et lui aussi fut un libérateur d''Israël.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የዓናት ልጅ ሰሜጋር ተነሣ፥ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንም ስድስት መቶ ሰው በበሬ መውጊያ ገደለ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ እስራኤልን አዳነ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, when Ehud was dead.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent encore ce qui déplaît à l''Eternel, après qu''Ehud fut mort.
verses.am: ናዖድም ከሞተ በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ገና ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel les vendit entre les mains de Jabin, roi de Canaan, qui régnait à Hatsor. Le chef de son armée était Sisera, et habitait à Haroscheth-Goïm.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በአሶር በነገሠው በከነዓን ንጉሥ በኢያቢስ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ የሠራዊቱም አለቃ በአሕዛብ አሪሶት የተቀመጠው ሲሣራ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the Lord: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël crièrent à l''Eternel, car Jabin avait neuf cents chars de fer, et il opprimait avec violence les enfants d''Israël depuis vingt ans.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፤ ዘጠኝ መቶ የብረት ሰረገሎች ነበሩትና፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ሀያ ዓመት ያህል እጅግ ያስጨንቃቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
verses.fr: Dans ce temps-là, Débora, prophétesse, femme de Lappidoth, était juge en Israël.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜም ነቢይቱ የለፊዶት ሚስት ዲቦራ በእስራኤል ላይ ትፈርድ ነበረች።

verses.en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.fr: Elle siégeait sous le palmier de Débora, entre Rama et Béthel, dans la montagne d''Ephraïm; et les enfants d''Israël montaient vers elle pour être jugés.
verses.am: እርስዋም በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር በራማና በቤቴል መካከል ካለው የዲቦራ ዛፍ ከሚባለው ከዘንባባው በታች ተቀምጣ ነበር፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እርስዋ ለፍርድ ይወጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the Lord God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
verses.fr: Elle envoya appeler Barak, fils d''Abinoam, de Kédesch-Nephthali, et elle lui dit: N''est-ce pas l''ordre qu''a donné l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël? Va, dirige-toi sur le mont Thabor, et prends avec toi dix mille hommes des enfants de Nephthali et des enfants de Zabulon;
verses.am: ልካም ከቃዴስ ንፍታሌም የአቢኒኤምን ልጅ ባርቅን ጠርታ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር። ሄደህ ወደ ታቦር ተራራ ውጣ፥ ከአንተም ጋር ከንፍታሌምና ከዛብሎን ልጆች አሥር ሺህ ሰዎች ውሰድ፤

verses.en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.
verses.fr: j''attirerai vers toi, au torrent de Kison, Sisera, chef de l''armée de Jabin, avec ses chars et ses troupes, et je le livrerai entre tes mains.
verses.am: እኔም የኢያቢስን ሠራዊት አለቃ ሲሣራን ሰረገሎቹንም ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ ወደ አንተ ወደ ቂሶን ወንዝ እስባለሁ፥ በእጅህም አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ ብሎ አላዘዘህምን? አለችው።

verses.en: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.
verses.fr: Barak lui dit: Si tu viens avec moi, j''irai; mais si tu ne viens pas avec moi, je n''irai pas.
verses.am: ባርቅም። አንቺ ከእኔ ጋር ብትሄጂ እኔ እሄዳለሁ፤ አንቺ ግን ከእኔ ጋር ባትሄጂ እኔ አልሄድም አላት።

verses.en: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the Lord shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.fr: Elle répondit: J''irai bien avec toi; mais tu n''auras point de gloire sur la voie où tu marches, car l''Eternel livrera Sisera entre les mains d''une femme. Et Débora se leva, et elle se rendit avec Barak à Kédesch.
verses.am: እርሷም። በእውነት ከአንተ ጋር እሄዳለሁ፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ሲሣራን በሴት እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣልና በዚህ በምትሄድበት መንገድ ለአንተ ክብር አይሆንም አለችው። ዲቦራም ተነሥታ ከባርቅ ጋር ወደ ቃዴስ ሄደች።

verses.en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
verses.fr: Barak convoqua Zabulon et Nephthali à Kédesch; dix mille hommes marchèrent à sa suite, et Débora partit avec lui.
verses.am: ባርቅም ዛብሎንንና ንፍታሌምን ወደ ቃዴስ ጠራቸው፥ አሥር ሺህም ሰዎች ተከትለውት ወጡ፤ ዲቦራም ከእርሱ ጋር ወጣች።

verses.en: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
verses.fr: Héber, le Kénien, s''était séparé des Kéniens, des fils de Hobab, beau-père de Moïse, et il avait dressé sa tente jusqu''au chêne de Tsaannaïm, près de Kédesch.
verses.am: ቄናዊውም ሔቤር ከሙሴ አማት ከኦባብ ልጆች ከቄናውያን ተለይቶ ድንኳኑን በቃዴስ አጠገብ በጻዕናይም እስከ ነበረው እስከ ትልቁ ዛፍ ድረስ ተከለ።

verses.en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
verses.fr: On informa Sisera que Barak, fils d''Abinoam, s''était dirigé sur le mont Thabor.
verses.am: የአቢኒኤምም ልጅ ባርቅ ወደ ታቦር ተራራ እንደ ወጣ ለሲሣራ ነገሩት።

verses.en: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
verses.fr: Et, depuis Haroscheth-Goïm, Sisera rassembla vers le torrent de Kison tous ses chars, neuf cents chars de fer, et tout le peuple qui était avec lui.
verses.am: ሲሣራም ሰረገሎቹን ሁሉ፥ ዘጠኝ መቶ የብረት ሰረገሎች፥ ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩትን ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ከአሪሶት ወደ ቂሶን ወንዝ ሰበሰባቸው።

verses.en: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the Lord hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the Lord gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
verses.fr: Alors Débora dit à Barak: Lève-toi, car voici le jour où l''Eternel livre Sisera entre tes mains. L''Eternel ne marche-t-il pas devant toi? Et Barak descendit du mont Thabor, ayant dix mille hommes à sa suite.
verses.am: ዲቦራም ባርቅን። እግዚአብሔር ሲሣራን በእጅህ አሳልፎ የሚሰጥበት ቀን ዛሬ ነውና ተነሣ፤ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በፊትህ ወጥቶአል አለችው። ባርቅም አሥር ሺህ ሰዎች ተከትለውት ከታቦር ተራራ ወረደ።

verses.en: And the Lord discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
verses.fr: L''Eternel mit en déroute devant Barak, par le tranchant de l''épée, Sisera, tous ses chars et tout le camp. Sisera descendit de son char, et s''enfuit à pied.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሲሣራን ሰረገሎቹንም ሁሉ ሠራዊቱንም ሁሉ ከባርቅ ፊት በሰይፍ ስለት አስደነገጣቸው፤ ሲሣራም ከሰረገላው ወርዶ በእግሩ ሸሸ።

verses.en: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
verses.fr: Barak poursuivit les chars et l''armée jusqu''à Haroscheth-Goïm; et toute l''armée de Sisera tomba sous le tranchant de l''épée, sans qu''il en restât un seul homme.
verses.am: ባርቅም ሰረገሎችንና ሠራዊቱን እስከ አሪሶት ድረስ አባረረ፤ የሲሣራም ሠራዊት ሁሉ በሰይፍ ስለት ወደቀ፤ አንድ እንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.en: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.fr: Sisera se réfugia à pied dans la tente de Jaël, femme de Héber, le Kénien; car il y avait paix entre Jabin, roi de Hatsor, et la maison de Héber, le Kénien.
verses.am: በአሶር ንጉሥም በኢያቢስና በቄናዊው በሔቤር ቤት መካከል ሰላም ነበረና ሲሣራ በእግሩ ሸሽቶ ወደ ቄናዊው ወደ ሔቤር ሚስት ወደ ኢያዔል ድንኳን ደረሰ።

verses.en: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
verses.fr: Jaël sortit au-devant de Sisera, et lui dit: Entre, mon seigneur, entre chez moi, ne crains point. Il entra chez elle dans la tente, et elle le cacha sous une couverture.
verses.am: ኢያዔልም ሲሣራን ለመገናኘት ወጥታ። ግባ፥ ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ወደ እኔ ግባ፤ አትፍራ አለችው። ወደ እርስዋም ወደ ድንኳንዋ ገባ፥ በመጐናጸፊያዋም ሸፈነችው።

verses.en: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Donne-moi, je te prie, un peu d''eau à boire, car j''ai soif. Elle ouvrit l''outre du lait, lui donna à boire, et le couvrit.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጠምቶኛልና እባክሽ የምጠጣው ጥቂት ውኃ ስጭኝ አላት፤ እርስዋም የወተቱን አቁማዳ ፈትታ አጠጣችው፥ ሸፈነችውም።

verses.en: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
verses.fr: Il lui dit encore: Tiens-toi à l''entrée de la tente, et si l''on vient t''interroger en disant: Y a-t-il ici quelqu''un? tu répondras: Non.
verses.am: እርሱም። ከድንኳኑ ደጃፍ ቁሚ፤ ሰውም መጥቶ። በዚህ ሰው አለን? ብሎ ቢጠይቅሽ አንቺ። የለም ትዪዋለሽ አላት።

verses.en: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
verses.fr: Jaël, femme de Héber, saisit un pieu de la tente, prit en main le marteau, s''approcha de lui doucement, et lui enfonça dans la tempe le pieu, qui pénétra en terre. Il était profondément endormi et accablé de fatigue; et il mourut.
verses.am: የሔቤርም ሚስት ኢያዔል የድንኳን ካስማ ወሰደች፥ በእጅዋም መዶሻ ያዘች፥ ቀስ ብላም ወደ እርሱ ቀረበች፤ በጆሮግንዱ ካስማውን ቸነከረች፤ እርሱም ደክሞ እንቀላፍቶ ነበርና ካስማው ወደ መሬት ጠለቀ፥ እርሱም ሞተ።

verses.en: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.
verses.fr: Comme Barak poursuivait Sisera, Jaël sortit à sa rencontre et lui dit: Viens, et je te montrerai l''homme que tu cherches. Il entra chez elle, et voici, Sisera était étendu mort, le pieu dans la tempe.
verses.am: የከነዓንን ንጉሥ ኢያቢስንም እስኪያጠፉ ድረስ በከነዓን ንጉሥ በኢያቢስ ላይ የእስራኤል ልጆች እጅ እየበረታች ሄደች።

verses.en: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
verses.fr: En ce jour, Dieu humilia Jabin, roi de Canaan, devant les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: የከነዓንን ንጉሥ ኢያቢስንም እስኪያጠፉ ድረስ በከነዓን ንጉሥ በኢያቢስ ላይ የእስራኤል ልጆች እጅ እየበረታች ሄደች።

verses.en: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.fr: Et la main des enfants d''Israël s''appesantit de plus en plus sur Jabin, roi de Canaan, jusqu''à ce qu''ils eussent exterminé Jabin, roi de Canaan.
verses.am: ፤ የከነዓንን ንጉሥ ኢያቢስንም እስኪያጠፉ ድረስ በከነዓን ንጉሥ በኢያቢስ ላይ የእስራኤል ልጆች እጅ እየበረታች ሄደች።

verses.en: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, Débora chanta ce cantique, avec Barak, fils d''Abinoam:
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ዲቦራና የአቢኒኤም ልጅ ባርቅ እንዲህ ብለው ተቀኙ።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
verses.fr: Des chefs se sont mis à la tête du peuple en Israël, Et le peuple s''est montré prêt à combattre: Bénissez-en l''Eternel!
verses.am: በእስራኤል ውስጥ መሪዎች ስለ መሩ፥  ሕዝቡም ነፍሳቸውን በፈቃዳቸው ስለ ሰጡ፥  እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the Lord; I will sing praise to the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: Rois, écoutez! Princes, prêtez l''oreille! Je chanterai, oui, je chanterai à l''Eternel, Je chanterai à l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ነገሥታት ሆይ፥ ስሙ፤  መኳንንት ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፤  እኔ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀኛለሁ፥  ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Lord, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
verses.fr: O Eternel! quand tu sortis de Séir, Quand tu t''avanças des champs d''Edom, La terre trembla, et les cieux se fondirent Et les nuées se fondirent en eaux;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከሴይር በወጣህ ጊዜ፥  ከኤዶምያስም ሜዳ በተራመድህ ጊዜ፥  ምድሪቱ ተናወጠች፥ ሰማያቱም አንጠበጠቡ፤  ደመናትም ደግሞ ውኃን አንጠበጠቡ።

verses.en: The mountains melted from before the Lord, even that Sinai from before the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: Les montagnes s''ébranlèrent devant l''Eternel, Ce Sinaï devant l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ተራሮች ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት የተነሣ ቀለጡ፥  ያም ሲና ከእስራኤል አምላክ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት የተነሣ።

verses.en: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
verses.fr: Au temps de Schamgar, fils d''Anath, Au temps de Jaël, les routes étaient abandonnées, Et ceux qui voyageaient prenaient des chemins détournés.
verses.am: በዓናት ልጅ በሰሜጋር ዘመን፥  በኢያዔል ዘመን መንገዶች ተቋረጡ፤  መንገደኞች በስርጥ መንገድ ይሄዱ ነበር።

verses.en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
verses.fr: Les chefs étaient sans force en Israël, sans force, Quand je me suis levée, moi, Débora, Quand je me suis levée comme une mère en Israël.
verses.am: አንቺ፥ ዲቦራ፥ እስክትነሽ ድረስ፥  ለእስራኤልም እናት ሆነሽ እስክትነሽ ድረስ፥  ኃያላን በእስራኤል ዘንድ አነሱ፥ አለቁም።

verses.en: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.fr: Il avait choisi de nouveaux dieux: Alors la guerre était aux portes; On ne voyait ni bouclier ni lance Chez quarante milliers en Israël.
verses.am: አዲሶች አማልክትን መረጡ፤  በዚያ ጊዜ ሰልፍ በበሮች ሆነ፤  በአርባ ሺህ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ጦርና ጋሻ አልታየም።

verses.en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Mon coeur est aux chefs d''Israël, A ceux du peuple qui se sont montrés prêts à combattre. Bénissez l''Eternel!
verses.am: ልቤ ወደ እስራኤል አለቆች ነው፥  በሕዝቡ መካከል ነፍሳቸውን በፈቃዳቸው ወደ ሰጡት፤  እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
verses.fr: Vous qui montez de blanches ânesses, Vous qui avez pour sièges des tapis, Et vous qui marchez sur la route, chantez!
verses.am: በነጫጭ አህዮች ላይ የምትጫኑ፥  በወላንሳ ላይ የምትቀመጡ፥  በመንገድም የምትሄዱ፥ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the Lord, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the Lord go down to the gates.
verses.fr: Que de leur voix les archers, du milieu des abreuvoirs, Célèbrent les bienfaits de l''Eternel, Les bienfaits de son conducteur en Israël! Alors le peuple de l''Eternel descendit aux portes.
verses.am: በማጠጫው መካከል ካሉት ከቀስተኞች ጩኸት ርቀው፥  በዚያ የእግዚአብሔርን ጽድቅ፥  በእስራኤል ላይ የግዛቱን ጽድቅ ይጫወታሉ፤  ከዚያም በኋላ የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ወደ በሮች ወረዱ።

verses.en: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
verses.fr: Réveille-toi, réveille-toi, Débora! Réveille-toi, réveille-toi, dis un cantique! Lève-toi, Barak, et emmène tes captifs, fils d''Abinoam!
verses.am: ንቂ፥ ንቂ፥ ዲቦራ ሆይ፤  ንቂ፥ ንቂ፥ ቅኔውን ተቀኚ፤  ባርቅ ሆይ፥ ተነሣ፤  የአቢኒኤም ልጅ ሆይ፥ ምርኮህን ማርክ።

verses.en: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the Lord made me have dominion over the mighty.
verses.fr: Alors un reste du peuple triompha des puissants, L''Eternel me donna la victoire sur les héros.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜ የቀሩት ወደ ኃያላኑና ወደ ሕዝቡ ወረዱ፤  እግዚአብሔርም ስለ እኔ በኃያላን ላይ ወረደ።

verses.en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
verses.fr: D''Ephraïm arrivèrent les habitants d''Amalek. A ta suite marcha Benjamin parmi ta troupe. De Makir vinrent des chefs, Et de Zabulon des commandants.
verses.am: በአማሌቅ ዘንድ ሥር የነበራቸው እነርሱ ከኤፍሬም፥  ብንያም ሆይ፥ በሕዝብህ መካከል ከአንተ በኋላ ወረዱ፤  አለቆች ከማኪር፥ የንጉሥንም ዘንግ የሚይዙ ከዛብሎን ወረዱ።

verses.en: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
verses.fr: Les princes d''Issacar furent avec Débora, Et Issacar suivit Barak, Il fut envoyé sur ses pas dans la vallée. Près des ruisseaux de Ruben, Grandes furent les résolutions du coeur!
verses.am: የይሳኮርም አለቆች ከዲቦራ ጋር ነበሩ፤  ይሳኮርም እንደ ባርቅ ነበረ፤  ከእግሩ በኋላ ወደ ሸለቆው ቸኰሉ፤  በሮቤል ፈሳሾች አጠገብ ብዙ የልብ ማመንታት ነበረ።

verses.en: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
verses.fr: Pourquoi es-tu resté au milieu des étables A écouter le bêlement des troupeaux? Aux ruisseaux de Ruben, Grandes furent les délibérations du coeur!
verses.am: መንጎች ሲያፍዋጩ ለመስማት  በበጎች ጕረኖ መካከል ለምን ተቀመጥህ?  በሮቤል ፈሳሾች አጠገብ ታላቅ የልብ ምርምር ነበረ።

verses.en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
verses.fr: Galaad au delà du Jourdain n''a pas quitté sa demeure. Pourquoi Dan s''est-il tenu sur les navires? Aser s''est assis sur le rivage de la mer, Et s''est reposé dans ses ports.
verses.am: ገለዓድ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ተቀመጠ፤  ዳንም ለምን በመርከብ ውስጥ ቀረ?  አሴርም በባሕሩ ዳር ተቀመጠ፥  በወንዞቹም ዳርቻ ዐረፈ።

verses.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
verses.fr: Zabulon est un peuple qui affronta la mort, Et Nephthali de même, Sur les hauteurs des champs.
verses.am: ዛብሎን ነፍሱን ወደ ሞት ያሳለፈ ሕዝብ ነው፥  ንፍታሌምም በአገሩ ኮረብታ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
verses.fr: Les rois vinrent, ils combattirent, Alors combattirent les rois de Canaan, A Thaanac, aux eaux de Meguiddo; Ils ne remportèrent nul butin, nul argent.
verses.am: ነገሥታት መጡ፥ ተዋጉም፤  በዚያ ጊዜ በመጊዶ ውኆች አጠገብ በታዕናክ  የከነዓን ነገሥታት ተዋጉ፤  የብር ዘረፋም አልወሰዱም።

verses.en: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
verses.fr: Des cieux on combattit, De leurs sentiers les étoiles combattirent contre Sisera.
verses.am: ከዋክብት ከሰማይ ተዋጉ፤  በአካሄዳቸውም ከሲሣራ ጋር ተዋጉ።

verses.en: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
verses.fr: Le torrent de Kison les a entraînés, Le torrent des anciens temps, le torrent de Kison. Mon âme, foule aux pieds les héros!
verses.am: ከዱሮ ጀምሮ የታወቀ ያ የቂሶን ወንዝ፥  የቂሶን ወንዝ ጠርጎ ወሰዳቸው።  ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ በኃይል እርገጪ።

verses.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
verses.fr: Alors les talons des chevaux retentirent, A la fuite, à la fuite précipitée de leurs guerriers.
verses.am: ከኃያላን ግልቢያ ብርታት የተነሣ  የፈረሶች ጥፍሮች ተቀጠቀጡ።

verses.en: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the Lord, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the Lord, to the help of the Lord against the mighty.
verses.fr: Maudissez Méroz, dit l''ange de l''Eternel, Maudissez, maudissez ses habitants, Car ils ne vinrent pas au secours de l''Eternel, Au secours de l''Eternel, parmi les hommes vaillants.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ። ሜሮዝን እርገሙ፤  እግዚአብሔርን በኃያላን መካከል ለመርዳት፥  እግዚአብሔርን ለመርዳት አልመጡምና  የተቀመጡባትን ሰዎች ፈጽማችሁ እርገሙ አለ።

verses.en: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.fr: Bénie soit entre les femmes Jaël, Femme de Héber, le Kénien! Bénie soit-elle entre les femmes qui habitent sous les tentes!
verses.am: የቄናዊው የሔቤር ሚስት ኢያዔል  ከሴቶች ይልቅ የተባረከች ትሁን፤  በድንኳን ውስጥ ከሚኖሩ ሴቶች ይልቅ የተባረከች ትሁን።

verses.en: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
verses.fr: Il demanda de l''eau, elle a donné du lait, Dans la coupe d''honneur elle a présenté de la crème.
verses.am: ውኃ ለመነ፥ ወተትም ሰጠችው፤  በተከበረ ዳካ እርጎ አቀረበችለት።

verses.en: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
verses.fr: D''une main elle a saisi le pieu, Et de sa droite le marteau des travailleurs; Elle a frappé Sisera, lui a fendu la tête, Fracassé et transpercé la tempe.
verses.am: እጅዋን ወደ ካስማ፥  ቀኝ እጅዋንም ወደ ሠራተኛ መዶሻ አደረገች፤  በመዶሻውም ሲሣራን መታች፥ ራሱንም ቸነከረች፤  ጆሮግንዱንም በሳች፥ ጎዳችውም።

verses.en: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.fr: Aux pieds de Jaël il s''est affaissé, il est tombé, il s''est couché; A ses pieds il s''est affaissé, il est tombé; Là où il s''est affaissé, là il est tombé sans vie.
verses.am: በእግሮችዋ አጠገብ ተደፋ፥ ወደቀ፥ ተኛ፤  በእግሮችዋ አጠገብ ተደፋ፥ ወደቀ፤  በተደፋበት ስፍራ በዚያ ወድቆ ሞተ።

verses.en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
verses.fr: Par la fenêtre, à travers le treillis, La mère de Sisera regarde, et s''écrie: Pourquoi son char tarde-t-il à venir? Pourquoi ses chars vont-ils si lentement?
verses.am: ከመስኮት ሆና ተመለከተች፤  የሲሣራ እናት በሰቅሰቅ ዘልቃ።  ስለ ምን ለመምጣት ሰረገላው ዘገየ?  ስለ ምንስ የሰረገላው መንኰራኵር ቈየ? ብላ ጮኸች።

verses.en: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
verses.fr: Les plus sages d''entre ses femmes lui répondent, Et elle se répond à elle-même:
verses.am: ብልሃተኞች ሴቶችዋ መለሱላት፤  እርስዋ ደግሞ ለራስዋ እንዲህ ብላ መለሰች።

verses.en: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
verses.fr: Ne trouvent-ils pas du butin? ne le partagent-ils pas? Une jeune fille, deux jeunes filles par homme, Du butin en vêtements de couleur pour Sisera, Du butin en vêtements de couleur, brodés, Un vêtement de couleur, deux vêtements brodés, Pour le cou du vainqueur.
verses.am: ምርኮ አግኝተው የለምን? ተካፍለውስ የለምን?  ለእያንዳንዱ ሰው ምርኮ አንዲት ወይም ሁለት ቈነጃጅት፤  ለሲሣራ ምርኮ ልዩ ልዩ ያለው ልብስ፥  በአንገትጌ ላይ በሁለት እጥፍ የተጠለፈ ዝንጕርጕር ልብስ።

verses.en: So let all thine enemies perish, O Lord: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verses.fr: Périssent ainsi tous tes ennemis, ô Eternel! Ceux qui l''aiment sont comme le soleil, Quand il paraît dans sa force. Le pays fut en repos pendant quarante ans.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጠላቶችህ ሁሉ እንዲሁ ይጥፉ፤  ወዳጆችህ ግን ፀሐይ በኃይሉ በወጣ ጊዜ እንደሚሆን፥ እንዲሁ ይሁኑ። ምድሪቱም አርባ ዓመት ያህል ዐረፈች።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent ce qui déplaît à l''Eternel; et l''Eternel les livra entre les mains de Madian, pendant sept ans.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በምድያም እጅ ሰባት ዓመት አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
verses.fr: La main de Madian fut puissante contre Israël. Pour échapper à Madian, les enfants d''Israël se retiraient dans les ravins des montagnes, dans les cavernes et sur les rochers fortifiés.
verses.am: የምድያምም እጅ በእስራኤል ላይ ጠነከረች፤ ከምድያምም የተነሣ የእስራኤል ልጆች በተራራ ላይ ጕድጓድና ዋሻ ምሽግም አበጁ።

verses.en: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
verses.fr: Quand Israël avait semé, Madian montait avec Amalek et les fils de l''Orient, et ils marchaient contre lui.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ዘር በዘሩ ጊዜ ምድያማውያን አማሌቃውያንም በምሥራቅም የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ይመጡባቸው ነበር፤

verses.en: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
verses.fr: Ils campaient en face de lui, détruisaient les productions du pays jusque vers Gaza, et ne laissaient en Israël ni vivres, ni brebis, ni boeufs, ni ânes.
verses.am: በእነርሱም ላይ ይሰፍሩ ነበር፥ እስከ ጋዛም ድረስ የምድሩን ቡቃያ ያጠፉ ነበር፥ ምግብንም ለእስራኤል አይተዉም ነበር፤ በግ ወይም በሬ ወይም አህያ ቢሆን አይተዉም።

verses.en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
verses.fr: Car ils montaient avec leurs troupeaux et leurs tentes, ils arrivaient comme une multitude de sauterelles, ils étaient innombrables, eux et leurs chameaux, et ils venaient dans le pays pour le ravager.
verses.am: እንስሶቻቸውንና ድንኳኖቻቸውን ይዘው በብዛት እንደ አንበጣ ሆነው ይመጡ ነበር፤ ለእነርሱና ለግመሎቻቸውም ቍጥር አልነበራቸውም፤ ምድሪቱንም ያጠፉ ዘንድ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Israël fut très malheureux à cause de Madian, et les enfants d''Israël crièrent à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከምድያምም የተነሣ እስራኤል እጅግ ተጠቁ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord because of the Midianites,
verses.fr: Lorsque les enfants d''Israël crièrent à l''Eternel au sujet de Madian,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች በምድያም ምክንያት ወደ እግዚአብሔር በጮኹ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That the Lord sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
verses.fr: l''Eternel envoya un prophète aux enfants d''Israël. Il leur dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Je vous ai fait monter d''Egypte, et je vous ai fait sortir de la maison de servitude.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ነቢይ ላከ፥ እርሱም አለ። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣኋችሁ፥ ከባርነትም ቤት አስለቀቅኋችሁ፤

verses.en: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
verses.fr: Je vous ai délivrés de la main des Egyptiens et de la main de tous ceux qui vous opprimaient; je les ai chassés devant vous, et je vous ai donné leur pays.
verses.am: ከግብፃውያንም እጅ፥ ከሚጋፉአችሁም ሁሉ እጅ አዳንኋችሁ፥ ከፊታችሁም አሳደድኋቸው፥ አገራቸውንም ሰጠኋችሁ፤

verses.en: And I said unto you, I am the Lord your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
verses.fr: Je vous ai dit: Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu; vous ne craindrez point les dieux des Amoréens, dans le pays desquels vous habitez. Mais vous n''avez point écouté ma voix.
verses.am: እናንተንም። እኔ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ በምድራቸው የተቀመጣችሁባቸውን የአሞራያውያንን አማልክት አትፍሩ አልኋችሁ። እናንተ ግን ድምፄን አልሰማችሁም።

verses.en: And there came an angel of the Lord, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
verses.fr: Puis vint l''ange de l''Eternel, et il s''assit sous le térébinthe d''Ophra, qui appartenait à Joas, de la famille d''Abiézer. Gédéon, son fils, battait du froment au pressoir, pour le mettre à l''abri de Madian.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ መጥቶ በዖፍራ ባለችው ለአቢዔዝራዊው ለኢዮአስ በነበረችው በአድባሩ ዛፍ በታች ተቀመጠ፤ ልጁም ጌዴዎን ከምድያማውያን ለመሸሸግ በወይን መጥመቂያው ውስጥ ስንዴ ይወቃ ነበር።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him, and said unto him, The Lord is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel lui apparut, et lui dit: L''Eternel est avec toi, vaillant héros!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ለእርሱ ተገልጦ። አንተ ጽኑዕ ኃያል ሰው፥ እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር ነው አለው።

verses.en: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the Lord be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the Lord bring us up from Egypt? but now the Lord hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
verses.fr: Gédéon lui dit: Ah! mon seigneur, si l''Eternel est avec nous, pourquoi toutes ces choses nous sont-elles arrivées? Et où sont tous ces prodiges que nos pères nous racontent, quand ils disent: L''Eternel ne nous a-t-il pas fait monter hors d''Egypte? Maintenant l''Eternel nous abandonne, et il nous livre entre les mains de Madian!
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ከሆነ ይህ ነገር ሁሉ ለምን ደረሰብን? አባቶቻችንስ። እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ አውጥቶናል ብለው ይነግሩን የነበረ ተአምራቱ ወዴት አለ? ወዴት አለ? አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔር ትቶናል፥ በምድያማውያንም እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶናል አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
verses.fr: L''Eternel se tourna vers lui, et dit: Va avec cette force que tu as, et délivre Israël de la main de Madian; n''est-ce pas moi qui t''envoie?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ወደ እርሱ ዘወር ብሎ። በዚህ በጕልበትህ ሂድ፥ እስራኤልንም ከምድያም እጅ አድን፤ እነሆ፥ ልኬሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
verses.fr: Gédéon lui dit: Ah! mon seigneur, avec quoi délivrerai-je Israël? Voici, ma famille est la plus pauvre en Manassé, et je suis le plus petit dans la maison de mon père.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እስራኤልን በምን አድናለሁ? ወገኔ ከምናሴ ነገድ ከሁሉ ይልቅ የተጠቃ ነው፤ እኔም በአባቴ ቤት የሁሉ ታናሽ ነኝ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit: Mais je serai avec toi, et tu battras Madian comme un seul homme.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። በእርግጥ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ ምድያምንም እንደ አንድ ሰው አድርገህ ትመታለህ አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.
verses.fr: Gédéon lui dit: Si j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, donne-moi un signe pour montrer que c''est toi qui me parles.
verses.am: እርሱም። በአንተ ዘንድ ሞገስ ካገኘሁ፥ የምትናገረኝም አንተ እንደ ሆንህ ምልክት አሳየኝ፤

verses.en: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
verses.fr: Ne t''éloigne point d''ici jusqu''à ce que je revienne auprès de toi, que j''apporte mon offrande, et que je la dépose devant toi. Et l''Eternel dit: Je resterai jusqu''à ce que tu reviennes.
verses.am: ወደ አንተም እስክመለስ ድረስ፥ ቍርባኔንም አምጥቼ እስካቀርብልህ ድረስ፥ እባክህ፥ ከዚህ አትላወስ አለው። እርሱም። እስክትመለስ ድረስ እቆያለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
verses.fr: Gédéon entra, prépara un chevreau, et fit avec un épha de farine des pains sans levain. Il mit la chair dans un panier et le jus dans un pot, les lui apporta sous le térébinthe, et les présenta.
verses.am: ጌዴዎን ገባ የፍየሉንም ጠቦት የኢፍ መስፈሪያም ዱቄት የቂጣ እንጎቻ አዘጋጀ፤ ሥጋውን በሌማት አኖረ፥ መረቁንም በምንቸት ውስጥ አደረገ፥ ሁሉንም ይዞ በአድባሩ ዛፍ በታች አቀረበለት።

verses.en: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
verses.fr: L''ange de Dieu lui dit: Prends la chair et les pains sans levain, pose-les sur ce rocher, et répands le jus. Et il fit ainsi.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ። ሥጋውንና የቂጣውን እንጎቻ ወስደህ በዚህ ድንጋይ ላይ አኑር፥ መረቁንም አፍስስ አለው። እንዲሁም አደረገ።

verses.en: Then the angel of the Lord put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the Lord departed out of his sight.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel avança l''extrémité du bâton qu''il avait à la main, et toucha la chair et les pains sans levain. Alors il s''éleva du rocher un feu qui consuma la chair et les pains sans levain. Et l''ange de l''Eternel disparut à ses yeux.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በእጁ ያለውን የበትሩን ጫፍ ዘርግቶ ሥጋውንና የቂጣውን እንጎቻ አስነካ፤ እሳትም ከድንጋዩ ውስጥ ወጥቶ ሥጋውንና የቂጣውን እንጎቻ በላ። የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ከዓይኑ ተሰወረ።

verses.en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the Lord, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord God! for because I have seen an angel of the Lord face to face.
verses.fr: Gédéon, voyant que c''était l''ange de l''Eternel, dit: Malheur à moi, Seigneur Eternel! car j''ai vu l''ange de l''Eternel face à face.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ እንደ ሆነ አየ፤ ጌዴዎንም። አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ወዮልኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ ፊት ለፊት አይቻለሁና አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel lui dit: Sois en paix, ne crains point, tu ne mourras pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን፤ አትፍራ፤ አትሞትም አለው።

verses.en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the Lord, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.fr: Gédéon bâtit là un autel à l''Eternel, et lui donna pour nom l''Eternel paix: il existe encore aujourd''hui à Ophra, qui appartenait à la famille d''Abiézer.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም በዚያ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ ስሙንም። እግዚአብሔር ሰላም ብሎ ጠራው። እርሱም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ለአቢዔዝራውያን በምትሆነው በዖፍራ አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the Lord said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:
verses.fr: Dans la même nuit, l''Eternel dit à Gédéon: Prends le jeune taureau de ton père, et un second taureau de sept ans. Renverse l''autel de Baal qui est à ton père, et abats le pieu sacré qui est dessus.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በዚያ ሌሊት። የአባትህን በሬ፥ ሰባት ዓመት የሆነውን ሁለተኛውን በሬ፥ ውሰድ፥ የአባትህ የሆነውንም የበኣል መሠዊያ አፍርስ፥ በእርሱም ዙሪያ ያለውን የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ቍረጥ፤

verses.en: And build an altar unto the Lord thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
verses.fr: Tu bâtiras ensuite et tu disposeras, sur le haut de ce rocher, un autel à l''Eternel ton Dieu. Tu prendras le second taureau, et tu offriras un holocauste, avec le bois de l''idole que tu auras abattue.
verses.am: በዚያም ኮረብታ አናት ላይ ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ አሳምረህ ሥራ ሁለተኛውንም በሬ ውሰድ፥ በዚያም በቈረጥኸው በማምለኪያ ዐፀዱ እንጨት ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቅርብ አለው።

verses.en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the Lord had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
verses.fr: Gédéon prit dix hommes parmi ses serviteurs, et fit ce que l''Eternel avait dit; mais, comme il craignait la maison de son père et les gens de la ville, il l''exécuta de nuit, et non de jour.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም ከባሪያዎቹ አሥር ሰዎችን ወስዶ እግዚአብሔር እንዳለው አደረገ፤ የአባቱን ቤተ ሰቦች የከተማውንም ሰዎች ስለ ፈራ ይህን በቀን ለማድረግ አልቻለም፥ ነገር ግን በሌሊት አደረገው።

verses.en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
verses.fr: Lorsque les gens de la ville se furent levés de bon matin, voici, l''autel de Baal était renversé, le pieu sacré placé dessus était abattu, et le second taureau était offert en holocauste sur l''autel qui avait été bâti.
verses.am: የከተማውም ሰዎች ማልደው ተነሡ፥ እነሆም፥ የበኣል መሠዊያ ፈርሶ፥ በዙሪያው ያለውም የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ተቈርጦ፥ በተሠራውም መሠዊያ ላይ ሁለተኛው በሬ ተሠውቶ አገኙት።

verses.en: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
verses.fr: Ils se dirent l''un à l''autre: Qui a fait cela? Et ils s''informèrent et firent des recherches. On leur dit: C''est Gédéon, fils de Joas, qui a fait cela.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ይህን ነገር ያደረገ ማን ነው? ተባባሉ። በጠየቁና በመረመሩም ጊዜ። ይህን ነገር ያደረገ የኢዮአስ ልጅ ጌዴዎን ነው አሉ።

verses.en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.
verses.fr: Alors les gens de la ville dirent à Joas: Fais sortir ton fils, et qu''il meure, car il a renversé l''autel de Baal et abattu le pieu sacré qui était dessus.
verses.am: የከተማውም ሰዎች ኢዮአስን። የበኣልን መሠዊያ አፍርሶአልና፥ በዙሪያውም ያለውን የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ቈርጦአልና እንዲሞት ልጅህን አውጣ አሉት።

verses.en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.
verses.fr: Joas répondit à tous ceux qui se présentèrent à lui: Est-ce à vous de prendre parti pour Baal? est-ce à vous de venir à son secours? Quiconque prendra parti pour Baal mourra avant que le matin vienne. Si Baal est un dieu, qu''il plaide lui-même sa cause, puisqu''on a renversé son autel.
verses.am: ኢዮአስም እርሱን የተቃወሙትን ሁሉ። ለበኣል ትምዋገቱለታላችሁን? ወይስ እርሱን ታድናላችሁን? የሚምዋገትለት ሁሉ እስከ ነገ ይሙት፤ እርሱ አምላክ ከሆነ መሠዊያውን ካፈረሰው ጋር ለራሱ ይምዋገት አላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
verses.fr: Et en ce jour l''on donna à Gédéon le nom de Jerubbaal, en disant: Que Baal plaide contre lui, puisqu''il a renversé son autel.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በዚያ ቀን። መሠዊያውን አፍርሶአልና በኣል ከእርሱ ጋር ይምዋገት ብሎ ጌዴዎንን። ይሩበኣል ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.fr: Tout Madian, Amalek et les fils de l''Orient, se rassemblèrent; ils passèrent le Jourdain, et campèrent dans la vallée de Jizréel.
verses.am: ምድያማውያንም አማሌቃውያንም ሁሉ የምሥራቅም ሰዎች አንድ ሆነው ተሰበሰቡ፥ ዮርዳኖስንም ተሻገሩ፥ በኢይዝራኤልም ሸለቆ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: But the Spirit of the Lord came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.
verses.fr: Gédéon fut revêtu de l''esprit de l''Eternel; il sonna de la trompette, et Abiézer fut convoqué pour marcher à sa suite.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በጌዴዎን ገባበት፥ እርሱም ቀንደ መለከቱን ነፋ፤ የአቢዔዝርም ሰዎች ተጠርተው በኋላው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
verses.fr: Il envoya des messagers dans tout Manassé, qui fut aussi convoqué pour marcher à sa suite. Il envoya des messagers dans Aser, dans Zabulon et dans Nephthali, qui montèrent à leur rencontre.
verses.am: ወደ ምናሴም ነገድ ሁሉ መልክተኞችን ሰደደ እነርሱም ደግሞ ተጠርተው በኋላው ተከተሉት፤ መልክተኞችንም ወደ አሴርና ወደ ዛብሎን ወደ ንፍታሌምም ሰደደ፥ እነርሱም ሊገናኙአቸው ወጡ።

verses.en: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
verses.fr: Gédéon dit à Dieu: Si tu veux délivrer Israël par ma main, comme tu l''as dit,
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም እግዚአብሔርን። እንደ ተናገርህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በእኔ እጅ ታድን እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.en: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
verses.fr: voici, je vais mettre une toison de laine dans l''aire; si la toison seule se couvre de rosée et que tout le terrain reste sec, je connaîtrai que tu délivreras Israël par ma main, comme tu l''as dit.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአውድማው ላይ የተባዘተ የበግ ጠጕር አኖራለሁ፤ በጠጕሩ ብቻ ላይ ጠል ቢሆን በምድሩም ሁሉ ደረቅ ቢሆን፥ እንደ ተናገርህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በእኔ እጅ እንድታድናቸው አውቃለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
verses.fr: Et il arriva ainsi. Le jour suivant, il se leva de bon matin, pressa la toison, et en fit sortir la rosée, qui donna de l''eau plein une coupe.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ሆነ፤ በነጋውም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ ጠጕሩንም ጨመቀው፥ ከጠጕሩም የተጨመቀው ጠል ቆሬ ሙሉ ውኃ ሆነ።

verses.en: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
verses.fr: Gédéon dit à Dieu: Que ta colère ne s''enflamme point contre moi, et je ne parlerai plus que cette fois: Je voudrais seulement faire encore une épreuve avec la toison: que la toison seule reste sèche, et que tout le terrain se couvre de rosée.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም እግዚአብሔርን። እኔ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ ስናገር አትቈጣኝ፤ እኔ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ በጠጕሩ፥ እባክህ፥ ልፈትን፤ አሁንም በጠጕሩ ብቻ ላይ ደረቅ ይሁን፥ በምድሩም ሁሉ ላይ ጠል ይሁን አለው።

verses.en: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
verses.fr: Et Dieu fit ainsi cette nuit-là. La toison seule resta sèche, et tout le terrain se couvrit de rosée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በዚያ ሌሊት እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ በጠጕሩ ብቻ ላይ ደረቅ ነበረ፥ በምድሩም ሁሉ ላይ ጠል ነበረ። a

verses.en: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
verses.fr: Jerubbaal, qui est Gédéon, et tout le peuple qui était avec lui, se levèrent de bon matin, et campèrent près de la source de Harod. Le camp de Madian était au nord de Gédéon, vers la colline de Moré, dans la vallée.
verses.am: ጌዴዎን የተባለውም ይሩበኣል ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ማልደው ተነሡ፥ በሐሮድ ምንጭ አጠገብም ሰፈሩ፤ የምድያምም ሰፈር ከእነርሱ ወደ ሰሜን በኩል በሞሬ ኮረብታ አጠገብ በሸለቆው ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Gédéon: Le peuple que tu as avec toi est trop nombreux pour que je livre Madian entre ses mains; il pourrait en tirer gloire contre moi, et dire: C''est ma main qui m''a délivré.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጌዴዎንን። ከአንተ ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ በዝቶአል፤ ስለዚህ እስራኤል። እጄ አዳነኝ ብሎ እንዳይታበይብኝ እኔ ምድያምን በእጃቸው አሳልፌ አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.en: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
verses.fr: Publie donc ceci aux oreilles du peuple: Que celui qui est craintif et qui a peur s''en retourne et s''éloigne de la montagne de Galaad. Vingt-deux mille hommes parmi le peuple s''en retournèrent, et il en resta dix mille.
verses.am: አሁንም እንግዲህ። የፈራ የደነገጠም ከገለዓድ ተራራ ተነሥቶ ይመለስ ብለህ በሕዝቡ ጆሮ አውጅ አለው። ከሕዝቡም ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ተመለሱ፥ አሥርም ሺህ ቀሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Gédéon: Le peuple est encore trop nombreux. Fais-les descendre vers l''eau, et là je t''en ferai le triage; celui dont je te dirai: Que celui-ci aille avec toi, ira avec toi; et celui dont je te dirai: Que celui-ci n''aille pas avec toi, n''ira pas avec toi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጌዴዎንን። ሕዝቡ ገና ብዙ ነው፤ ወደ ውኃ አውርዳቸው፥ በዚያም እፈትናቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም። ይህ ከአንተ ጋር ይሂድ የምለው እርሱ ከአንተ ጋር ይሄዳል፤ እኔም። ይህ ከአንተ ጋር አይሂድ የምለው እርሱ አይሄድም አለው።

verses.en: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the Lord said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
verses.fr: Gédéon fit descendre le peuple vers l''eau, et l''Eternel dit à Gédéon: Tous ceux qui laperont l''eau avec la langue comme lape le chien, tu les sépareras de tous ceux qui se mettront à genoux pour boire.
