verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ወደ ውኃ አወረደ። እግዚአብሔርም ጌዴዎንን። ውሻ እንደሚጠጣ ውኃ በምላሱ የሚጠጣውን ሁሉ፥ እርሱን ለብቻው አድርገው፤ እንዲሁም ሊጠጣ በጕልበቱ የሚንበረከከውን ሁሉ ለብቻው አድርገው አለው።

verses.en: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
verses.fr: Ceux qui lapèrent l''eau en la portant à la bouche avec leur main furent au nombre de trois cents hommes, et tout le reste du peuple se mit à genoux pour boire.
verses.am: በእጃቸውም ውኃ ወደ አፋቸው አድርገው የጠጡት ቍጥር ሦስት መቶ ነበረ፤ የቀሩት ሕዝብ ግን ውኃ ሊጠጡ በጕልበታቸው ተንበረከኩ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Gédéon: C''est par les trois cents hommes qui ont lapé, que je vous sauverai et que je livrerai Madian entre tes mains. Que tout le reste du peuple s''en aille chacun chez soi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጌዴዎንን። በእጃቸው ውኃ በጠጡት በሦስት መቶ ሰዎች አድናችኋለሁ፥ ምድያማውያንንም በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ የቀሩት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ግን ወደ ስፍራቸው ይመለሱ አለው።

verses.en: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
verses.fr: On prit les vivres du peuple et ses trompettes. Puis Gédéon renvoya tous les hommes d''Israël chacun dans sa tente, et il retint les trois cents hommes. Le camp de Madian était au-dessous de lui dans la vallée.
verses.am: የሕዝቡንም ስንቅና ቀንደ መለከት በእጃቸው ወሰዱ፤ የቀሩትንም የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ ወደ ድንኳናቸው ሰደዳቸው፥ ሦስቱን መቶ ሰዎች ግን በእርሱ ዘንድ ጠበቃቸው፤ የምድያምም ሰፈር ከእርሱ በታች በሸለቆው ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the Lord said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Gédéon pendant la nuit: Lève-toi, descends au camp, car je l''ai livré entre tes mains.
verses.am: በዚያም ሌሊት እግዚአብሔር። በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻቸዋለሁና ተነሥተህ ወደ ሰፈር ውረድ።

verses.en: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:
verses.fr: Si tu crains de descendre, descends-y avec Pura, ton serviteur.
verses.am: አንተም ለመውረድ ብትፈራ አንተ ከሎሌህ ከፉራ ጋር ወደ ሰፈሩ ውረድ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.
verses.fr: Tu écouteras ce qu''ils diront, et après cela tes mains seront fortifiées: descends donc au camp. Il descendit avec Pura, son serviteur, jusqu''aux avant-postes du camp.
verses.am: የሚናገሩትንም ትሰማለህ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ትወርድ ዘንድ እጅህ ትበረታለች አለው። እርሱና ሎሌው ፉራ በሰፈሩ ዳርቻ ወደ ነበሩት ሰልፈኞች ወረዱ።

verses.en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.
verses.fr: Madian, Amalek, et tous les fils de l''Orient, étaient répandus dans la vallée comme une multitude de sauterelles, et leurs chameaux étaient innombrables comme le sable qui est sur le bord de la mer.
verses.am: ብዛታቸውም እንደ አንበጣ የሆነ ምድያማውያንና አማሌቃውያን የምሥራቅም ሰዎች ሁሉ በሸለቆው ውስጥ ሰፍረው ነበር፤ የግመሎቻቸውም ብዛት ቍጥር እንደ ሌለው በባሕር ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
verses.fr: Gédéon arriva; et voici, un homme racontait à son camarade un songe. Il disait: J''ai eu un songe; et voici, un gâteau de pain d''orge roulait dans le camp de Madian; il est venu heurter jusqu''à la tente, et elle est tombée; il l''a retournée sens dessus dessous, et elle a été renversée.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም በደረሰ ጊዜ አንድ ሰው ሕልምን ለባልንጀራው ሲያጫውት። እነሆ፥ ሕልም አለምሁ፤ እነሆም፥ አንዲት የገብስ እንጎቻ ወደ ምድያም ሰፈር ተንከባልላ ወረደች፥ ወደ ድንኳኑም ደርሳ እስኪወድቅ ድረስ መታችው፥ ገለበጠችውም፥ ድንኳኑም ተጋደመ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.
verses.fr: Son camarade répondit, et dit: Ce n''est pas autre chose que l''épée de Gédéon, fils de Joas, homme d''Israël; Dieu a livré entre ses mains Madian et tout le camp.
verses.am: ባልንጀራውም መልሶ። ይህ ነገር ከእስራኤል ሰው ከኢዮአስ ልጅ ከጌዴዎን ሰይፍ በቀር ሌላ አይደለም፤ እግዚአብሔር ምድያምንና ሠራዊቱን ሁሉ በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአል አለው።

verses.en: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the Lord hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
verses.fr: Lorsque Gédéon eut entendu le récit du songe et son explication, il se prosterna, revint au camp d''Israël, et dit: Levez-vous, car l''Eternel a livré entre vos mains le camp de Madian.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም ሕልሙንና ትርጓሜውን በሰማ ጊዜ ሰገደ፤ ወደ እስራኤልም ሰፈር ተመልሶ። እግዚአብሔር የምድያምን ሠራዊት በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና ተነሡ አለ።

verses.en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
verses.fr: Il divisa en trois corps les trois cents hommes, et il leur remit à tous des trompettes et des cruches vides, avec des flambeaux dans les cruches.
verses.am: ሦስቱንም መቶ ሰዎች በሦስት ወገን ከፈላቸው፥ በሁሉም እጅ ቀንደ መለከትና ባዶ ማሰሮ፥ በማሰሮውም ውስጥ ችቦ ሰጠ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Vous me regarderez et vous ferez comme moi. Dès que j''aborderai le camp, vous ferez ce que je ferai;
verses.am: እርሱም። እኔን ተመልከቱ፥ እንዲሁም አድርጉ፤ እነሆም፥ ወደ ሰፈሩ ዳርቻ በደረስሁ ጊዜ እኔ እንደማደርግ እንዲሁ እናንተ አድርጉ፤

verses.en: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon.
verses.fr: et quand je sonnerai de la trompette, moi et tous ceux qui seront avec moi, vous sonnerez aussi de la trompette tout autour du camp, et vous direz: Pour l''Eternel et pour Gédéon!
verses.am: እኔ ከእኔም ጋር ያሉት ሁሉ ቀንደ መለከት ስንነፋ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ሁሉ ቀንደ መለከታችሁን ንፉ። ለእግዚአብሔርና ለጌዴዎን በሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.
verses.fr: Gédéon et les cent hommes qui étaient avec lui arrivèrent aux abords du camp au commencement de la veille du milieu, comme on venait de placer les gardes. Ils sonnèrent de la trompette, et brisèrent les cruches qu''ils avaient à la main.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም ከእርሱም ጋር የነበሩት መቶ ሰዎች በመካከለኛው ትጋት ትጋቱም በተጀመረ ጊዜ ወደ ሰፈሩ ዳርቻ መጡ፤ ቀንደ መለከቶችንም ነፉ፥ በእጃቸውም የነበሩትን ማሰሮች ሰባበሩ።

verses.en: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon.
verses.fr: Les trois corps sonnèrent de la trompette, et brisèrent les cruches; ils saisirent de la main gauche les flambeaux et de la main droite les trompettes pour sonner, et ils s''écrièrent: Epée pour l''Eternel et pour Gédéon!
verses.am: ሦስቱም ወገኖች ቀንደ መለከቶችን ነፉ፥ ማሰሮችንም ሰበሩ፥ በግራ እጃቸውም ችቦችን፥ በቀኝ እጃቸውም ቀንደ መለከቶችን ይዘው እየነፉ። የእግዚአብሔርና የጌዴዎን ሰይፍ ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.
verses.fr: Ils restèrent chacun à sa place autour du camp, et tout le camp se mit à courir, à pousser des cris, et à prendre la fuite.
verses.am: ሁሉም በየቦታው በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ቆመ፤ ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ሮጠ፥ ጮኸ፥ ሸሸም።

verses.en: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the Lord set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.
verses.fr: Les trois cents hommes sonnèrent encore de la trompette; et, dans tout le camp, l''Eternel leur fit tourner l''épée les uns contre les autres. Le camp s''enfuit jusqu''à Beth-Schitta vers Tseréra, jusqu''au bord d''Abel-Mehola près de Tabbath.
verses.am: ሦስቱንም መቶ ቀንደ መለከቶች ነፉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የሰውን ሁሉ ሰይፍ በባልንጀራውና በሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ላይ አደረገ፤ ሠራዊቱም በጽሬራ በኩል እስከ ቤትሺጣ ድረስ በጠባት አጠገብ እስካለው እስከ አቤልምሖላ ዳርቻ ድረስ ሸሸ።

verses.en: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
verses.fr: Les hommes d''Israël se rassemblèrent, ceux de Nephthali, d''Aser et de tout Manassé, et ils poursuivirent Madian.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ከንፍታሌምና ከአሴር ከምናሴም ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ምድያምን አሳደዱ።

verses.en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.
verses.fr: Gédéon envoya des messagers dans toute la montagne d''Ephraïm, pour dire: Descendez à la rencontre de Madian, et coupez-leur le passage des eaux jusqu''à Beth-Bara et celui du Jourdain. Tous les hommes d''Ephraïm se rassemblèrent et ils s''emparèrent du passage des eaux jusqu''à Beth-Bara et de celui du Jourdain.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም። ምድያምን ለመገናኘት ውረዱ፥ እስከ ቤትባራም ድረስ ያለውን ውኃ፥ ዮርዳኖስን፥ ያዙባቸው ብሎ መልክተኞችን በኤፍሬም ወዳለው ተራራማ አገር ሁሉ ሰደደ። የኤፍሬም ሰዎችም ሁሉ ተሰብስበው እስከ ቤትባራ ድረስ ውኃውን፥ ዮርዳኖስን፥ ያዙ።

verses.en: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.
verses.fr: Ils saisirent deux chefs de Madian, Oreb et Zeeb; ils tuèrent Oreb au rocher d''Oreb, et ils tuèrent Zeeb au pressoir de Zeeb. Ils poursuivirent Madian, et ils apportèrent les têtes d''Oreb et de Zeeb à Gédéon de l''autre côté du Jourdain.
verses.am: የምድያምን ሁለቱን መኳንንት ሔሬብንና ዜብን ያዙ፤ ሔሬብንም በሔሬብ ዓለት አጠገብ ገደሉት፥ ዜብንም በዜብ መጥመቂያ ላይ ገደሉት፤ ምድያምንም አሳደዱ፥ የሔሬብንና የዜብንም ራስ ይዘው ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደ ጌዴዎን መጡ።

verses.en: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
verses.fr: Les hommes d''Ephraïm dirent à Gédéon: Que signifie cette manière d''agir envers nous? pourquoi ne pas nous avoir appelés, quand tu es allé combattre Madian? Et ils eurent avec lui une violente querelle.
verses.am: የኤፍሬም ሰዎች። ይህ ያደረግህብን ምንድር ነው? ምድያምን ለመዋጋት በወጣህ ጊዜ ለምን አልጠራኸንም? አሉት። ጽኑ ጥልም ተጣሉት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
verses.fr: Gédéon leur répondit: Qu''ai-je fait en comparaison de vous? Le grappillage d''Ephraïm ne vaut-il pas mieux que la vendange d''Abiézer?
verses.am: እርሱም። እኔ ካደረግሁት እናንተ ያደረጋችሁት አይበልጥምን? የኤፍሬም ወይን ቃርሚያ ከአቢዔዝር ወይን መከር አይሻልምን?

verses.en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
verses.fr: C''est entre vos mains que Dieu a livré les chefs de Madian, Oreb et Zeeb. Qu''ai-je donc pu faire en comparaison de vous? Lorsqu''il eut ainsi parlé, leur colère contre lui s''apaisa.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የምድያምን መኳንንት ሔሬብንና ዜብን በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአቸዋል፤ እናንተ ያደረጋችሁትን የሚመስል እኔ ምን ማድረግ እችል ኖሮአል? አላቸው። ይህን በተናገረ ጊዜ ቍጣቸው በረደ።

verses.en: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.
verses.fr: Gédéon arriva au Jourdain, et il le passa, lui et les trois cents hommes qui étaient avec lui, fatigués, mais poursuivant toujours.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም ከሦስቱ መቶ ሰዎች ጋር ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ደርሶ ተሻገረ፤ ምንም እንኳ ቢደክሙ ያሳድዱ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
verses.fr: Il dit aux gens de Succoth: Donnez, je vous prie, quelques pains au peuple qui m''accompagne, car ils sont fatigués, et je suis à la poursuite de Zébach et de Tsalmunna, rois de Madian.
verses.am: የሱኮትንም ሰዎች። የምድያምን ነገሥታት ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን ሳሳድድ፥ ደክመዋልና እኔን ለተከተሉ ሕዝብ እንጀራ፥ እባካችሁ፥ ስጡ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
verses.fr: Les chefs de Succoth répondirent: La main de Zébach et de Tsalmunna est-elle déjà en ton pouvoir, pour que nous donnions du pain à ton armée?
verses.am: የሱኮትም አለቆች። እኛ ለሠራዊትህ እንጀራ እንድንሰጥ የዛብሄልና የስልማና እጅ አሁን በእጅህ ነውን? አሉ።

verses.en: And Gideon said, Therefore when the Lord hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
verses.fr: Et Gédéon dit: Eh bien! lorsque l''Eternel aura livré entre mes mains Zébach et Tsalmunna, je broierai votre chair avec des épines du désert et avec des chardons.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም። እግዚአብሔር ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን በእጄ አሳልፎ ሲሰጠኝ እኔ በምድረ በዳ እሾህና በኵርንችት ሥጋችሁን እገርፋለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.
verses.fr: De là il monta à Penuel, et il fit aux gens de Penuel la même demande. Ils lui répondirent comme avaient répondu ceux de Succoth.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወደ ጵኒኤል ወጣ፥ ለጵኒኤልም ሰዎች እንዲሁ አላቸው፤ የጵንኤልም ሰዎች የሱኮት ሰዎች እንደ መለሱ መለሱለት።

verses.en: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
verses.fr: Et il dit aussi aux gens de Penuel: Quand je reviendrai en paix, je renverserai cette tour.
verses.am: እርሱም የጵኒኤልን ሰዎች ደግሞ። በደኅና በተመለስሁ ጊዜ ይህን ግንብ አፈርሰዋለሁ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
verses.fr: Zébach et Tsalmunna étaient à Karkor et leur armée avec eux, environ quinze mille hommes, tous ceux qui étaient restés de l''armée entière des fils de l''Orient; cent vingt mille hommes tirant l''épée avaient été tués.
verses.am: ዛብሄልና ስልማናም ከሠራዊቶቻቸው ጋር በቀርቀር ነበሩ፤ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ መቶ ሀያ ሺህ ሰዎች ወድቀው ነበርና ከምሥራቅ ሰዎች ሠራዊት ሁሉ የቀሩ አሥራ አምስት ሺህ ያህል ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host; for the host was secure.
verses.fr: Gédéon monta par le chemin de ceux qui habitent sous les tentes, à l''orient de Nobach et de Jogbeha, et il battit l''armée qui se croyait en sûreté.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም የድንኳን ተቀማጮች ባሉበት መንገድ በኖባህና በዮግብሃ በምሥራቅ በኩል ወጣ፤ ሠራዊቱም ተዘልሎ ነበርና ሠራዊቱን መታ።

verses.en: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
verses.fr: Zébach et Tsalmunna prirent la fuite; Gédéon les poursuivit, il s''empara des deux rois de Madian, Zébach et Tsalmunna, et il mit en déroute toute l''armée.
verses.am: ዛብሄልና ስልማናም ሸሹ፤ እርሱም አሳደዳቸው፥ ሁለቱንም የምድያም ነገሥታት ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን ያዘ፥ ሠራዊቱንም ሁሉ አስደነገጠ።

verses.en: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,
verses.fr: Gédéon, fils de Joas, revint de la bataille par la montée de Hérès.
verses.am: የኢዮአስ ልጅም ጌዴዎን ከሔሬስ ዳገት ከሰልፍ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.
verses.fr: Il saisit d''entre les gens de Succoth un jeune homme qu''il interrogea, et qui lui mit par écrit les noms des chefs et des anciens de Succoth, soixante-dix-sept hommes.
verses.am: ከሱኮትም ሰዎች አንድ ብላቴና ይዞ ጠየቀው፤ እርሱም የሱኮትን አለቆችና ሽማግሌዎች ሰባ ሳባት ሰዎች ጻፈለት።

verses.en: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
verses.fr: Puis il vint auprès des gens de Succoth, et dit: Voici Zébach et Tsalmunna, au sujet desquels vous m''avez insulté, en disant: La main de Zébach et de Tsalmunna est-elle déjà en ton pouvoir, pour que nous donnions du pain à tes hommes fatigués?
verses.am: ወደ ሱኮትም ሰዎች መጥቶ። ለደከሙት ሰዎችህ እንጀራ እንሰጥ ዘንድ የዛብሄልና የስልማና እጅ አሁን በእጅህ ነውን? ብላችሁ የተላገዳችሁብኝ፥ ዛብሄልና ስልማና እነሆ፥ አለ።

verses.en: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
verses.fr: Et il prit les anciens de la ville, et châtia les gens de Succoth avec des épines du désert et avec des chardons.
verses.am: የከተማይቱንም ሽማግሌዎች ያዘ፥ የምድረ በዳንም እሾህና ኵርንችት ወስዶ የሱኮትን ሰዎች ገረፋቸው።

verses.en: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
verses.fr: Il renversa aussi la tour de Penuel, et tua les gens de la ville.
verses.am: የጵኒኤልንም ግንብ አፈረሰ፥ የከተማይቱንም ሰዎች ገደላቸው።

verses.en: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
verses.fr: Il dit à Zébach et à Tsalmunna: Comment étaient les hommes que vous avez tués au Thabor? Ils répondirent: Ils étaient comme toi, chacun avait l''air d''un fils de roi.
verses.am: ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን። በታቦር የገደላችኋቸው ሰዎች እንዴት ያሉ ነበሩ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እንደ አንተ ያሉ ነበሩ፥ አንተንም ይመስሉ ነበር፤ መልካቸውም እንደ ንጉሥ ልጆች መልክ ነበረ ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.en: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the Lord liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
verses.fr: Il dit: C''étaient mes frères, fils de ma mère. L''Eternel est vivant! si vous les eussiez laissés vivre, je ne vous tuerais pas.
verses.am: እርሱም። የእናቴ ልጆች ወንድሞቼ ነበሩ፤ አድናችኋቸው ቢሆን ኖሮ፥ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እኔ አልገድላችሁም ነበር አለ።

verses.en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.
verses.fr: Et il dit à Jéther, son premier-né: Lève-toi, tue-les! Mais le jeune homme ne tira point son épée, parce qu''il avait peur, car il était encore un enfant.
verses.am: በኵሩንም ዬቴርን። ተነሥተህ ግደላቸው አለው፤ ብላቴናው ግን ገና ብላቴና ነበረና ስለ ፈራ ሰይፉን አልመዘዘም።

verses.en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.
verses.fr: Zébach et Tsalmunna dirent: Lève-toi toi-même, et tue-nous! car tel est l''homme, telle est sa force. Et Gédéon se leva, et tua Zébach et Tsalmunna. Il prit ensuite les croissants qui étaient aux cous de leurs chameaux.
verses.am: ዛብሄልና ስልማናም። የሰው ኃይሉ እንደ ሰውነቱ ነውና አንተ ተነሥተህ ውደቅብን አሉት። ጌዴዎንም ተነሥቶ ዛብሄልንና ስልማናን ገደለ፥ በግመሎቻቸውም አንገት የነበሩትን ሥሉሴዎች ማረከ።

verses.en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
verses.fr: Les hommes d''Israël dirent à Gédéon: Domine sur nous, et toi, et ton fils, et le fils de ton fils, car tu nous as délivrés de la main de Madian.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ጌዴዎንን። ከምድያም እጅ አድነኸናልና አንተ ልጅህም የልጅ ልጅህም ደግሞ ግዙን አሉት።

verses.en: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the Lord shall rule over you.
verses.fr: Gédéon leur dit: Je ne dominerai point sur vous, et mes fils ne domineront point sur vous; c''est l''Eternel qui dominera sur vous.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም። እኔ አልገዛችሁም፥ ልጄም አይገዛችሁም፤ እግዚአብሔር ይገዛችኋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
verses.fr: Gédéon leur dit: J''ai une demande à vous faire: donnez-moi chacun les anneaux que vous avez eus pour butin. -Les ennemis avaient des anneaux d''or, car ils étaient Ismaélites. -
verses.am: እስማኤላውያንም ስለ ነበሩ የወርቅ ጕትቻ ነበራቸውና ጌዴዎን። ሁላችሁ ከምርኮአችሁ ጕትቻችሁን እንድትሰጡኝ እለምናችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
verses.fr: Ils dirent: Nous les donnerons volontiers. Et ils étendirent un manteau, sur lequel chacun jeta les anneaux de son butin.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ፈቅደን እንሰጥሃለን ብለው መለሱለት። መጎናጸፊያም አነጠፉ፥ ሰውም ሁሉ የምርኮውን ጕትቻ በዚያ ላይ ጣለ።

verses.en: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.
verses.fr: Le poids des anneaux d''or que demanda Gédéon fut de mille sept cents sicles d''or, sans les croissants, les pendants d''oreilles, et les vêtements de pourpre que portaient les rois de Madian, et sans les colliers qui étaient aux cous de leurs chameaux.
verses.am: የለመነውም የወርቅ ጕትቻ ሚዛኑ፥ ከአምባሩ፥ ከድሪውም፥ የምድያምም ነገሥታት ከለበሱት ከቀዩ ቀሚስ፥ በግመሎቻቸውም አንገት ከነበሩት ሥሉሴዎች ሌላ፥ ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሰቅለ ወርቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
verses.fr: Gédéon en fit un éphod, et il le plaça dans sa ville, à Ophra, où il devint l''objet des prostitutions de tout Israël; et il fut un piège pour Gédéon et pour sa maison.
verses.am: ጌዴዎንም ኤፉድ አድርጎ አሠራው፥ በከተማውም በዖፍራ አኖረው፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ተከትሎት አመነዘረበት፤ ለጌዴዎንና ለቤቱም ወጥመድ ሆነ።

verses.en: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.fr: Madian fut humilié devant les enfants d''Israël, et il ne leva plus la tête. Et le pays fut en repos pendant quarante ans, durant la vie de Gédéon.
verses.am: ምድያምም በእስራኤል ልጆች ተዋረደ፥ ራሳቸውንም ዳግመኛ አላነሡም፤ በጌዴዎንም ዕድሜ ምድሪቱ አርባ ዓመት ዐረፈች።

verses.en: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
verses.fr: Jerubbaal, fils de Joas, s''en retourna, et demeura dans sa maison.
verses.am: የኢዮአስም ልጅ ይሩበኣል ሄዶ በቤቱ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.
verses.fr: Gédéon eut soixante-dix fils, issus de lui, car il eut plusieurs femmes.
verses.am: ለጌዴዎንም ብዙ ሚስቶች ነበሩትና ከወገቡ የወጡ ሰባ ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
verses.fr: Sa concubine, qui était à Sichem, lui enfanta aussi un fils, à qui on donna le nom d''Abimélec.
verses.am: በሴኬምም የነበረችው ቁባቱ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደችለት፥ ስሙንም አቤሜሌክ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.fr: Gédéon, fils de Joas, mourut après une heureuse vieillesse; et il fut enterré dans le sépulcre de Joas, son père, à Ophra, qui appartenait à la famille d''Abiézer.
verses.am: የኢዮአስም ልጅ ጌዴዎን በመልካም ሽምግልና ሞተ፥ በአቢዔዝራውያንም ከተማ በዖፍራ በነበረችው በአባቱ በኢዮአስ መቃብር ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.
verses.fr: Lorsque Gédéon fut mort, les enfants d''Israël recommencèrent à se prostituer aux Baals, et ils prirent Baal-Berith pour leur dieu.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ጌዴዎን ከሞተ በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች ተመለሱ፥ በኣሊምንም ተከትለው አመነዘሩ፤ በኣልብሪትንም አምላካቸው አደረጉ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel remembered not the Lord their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël ne se souvinrent point de l''Eternel, leur Dieu, qui les avait délivrés de la main de tous les ennemis qui les entouraient.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በዙሪያቸው ከነበሩት ከጠላቶቻቸው ሁሉ እጅ ያዳናቸውን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን አላሰቡትም፤

verses.en: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
verses.fr: Et ils n''eurent point d''attachement pour la maison de Jerubbaal, de Gédéon, après tout le bien qu''il avait fait à Israël.
verses.am: እርሱም ለእስራኤል በጎ ነገርን ሁሉ እንዳደረገ መጠን፥ እነርሱ ለጌዴዎን ለይሩበኣል ቤት ወረታ አላደረጉም።

verses.en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
verses.fr: Abimélec, fils de Jerubbaal, se rendit à Sichem vers les frères de sa mère, et voici comment il leur parla, ainsi qu''à toute la famille de la maison du père de sa mère:
verses.am: የይሩበኣል ልጅ አቤሜሌክም ወደ ሴኬም ወደ እናቱ ወንድሞች ሄደ፥ ለእነርሱም ለእናቱ አባት ቤተ ሰቦችም ሁሉ።

verses.en: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
verses.fr: Dites, je vous prie, aux oreilles de tous les habitants de Sichem: Vaut-il mieux pour vous que soixante-dix hommes, tous fils de Jerubbaal, dominent sur vous, ou qu''un seul homme domine sur vous? Et souvenez-vous que je suis votre os et votre chair.
verses.am: በሴኬም ሰዎች ሁሉ ጆሮ። ሰባ የሆኑት የይሩበኣል ልጆች ሁሉ ቢገዙአችሁ ወይስ አንድ ሰው ቢገዛችሁ ምን ይሻላችኋል? ብላችሁ ንገሩአቸው ብዬ እለምናችኋለሁ፤ ደግሞ እኔ የአጥንታችሁ ፍላጭ የሥጋችሁ ቍራጭ እንደ ሆንሁ አስቡ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
verses.fr: Les frères de sa mère répétèrent pour lui toutes ces paroles aux oreilles de tous les habitants de Sichem, et leur coeur inclina en faveur d''Abimélec, car ils se disaient: C''est notre frère.
verses.am: የእናቱም ወንድሞች ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ በሴኬም ሰዎች ሁሉ ጆሮ ተናገሩ፤ እነርሱም። እርሱ ወንድማችን ነው ብለው አቤሜሌክን ለመከተል ልባቸውን አዘነበሉት።

verses.en: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
verses.fr: Ils lui donnèrent soixante-dix sicles d''argent, qu''ils enlevèrent de la maison de Baal-Berith. Abimélec s''en servit pour acheter des misérables et des turbulents, qui allèrent après lui.
verses.am: ከበኣልብሪትም ቤት ሰባ ብር ሰጡት፤ በዚያም አቤሜሌክ ምናምንቴዎችንና ወሮበሎችን ቀጠረበት፥ እነርሱም ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.fr: Il vint dans la maison de son père à Ophra, et il tua ses frères, fils de Jerubbaal, soixante-dix hommes, sur une même pierre. Il n''échappa que Jotham, le plus jeune fils de Jerubbaal, car il s''était caché.
verses.am: ወደ አባቱም ቤት ወደ ዖፍራ ሄደ፤ ሰባ የሆኑትን የይሩበኣልን ልጆች ወንድሞቹን በአንድ ድንጋይ ላይ አረዳቸው፤ ትንሹ የይሩበኣል ልጅ ኢዮአታም ግን ተሸሽጎ ነበርና ተረፈ።

verses.en: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.fr: Tous les habitants de Sichem et toute la maison de Millo se rassemblèrent; ils vinrent, et proclamèrent roi Abimélec, près du chêne planté dans Sichem.
verses.am: የሴኬምም ሰዎች ሁሉ ቤትሚሎም ሁሉ ተሰበሰቡ፥ ሄደውም በሴኬም በዓምዱ አጠገብ ባለው በአድባሩ ዛፍ በታች አቤሜሌክን አነገሡ።

verses.en: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
verses.fr: Jotham en fut informé. Il alla se placer sur le sommet de la montagne de Garizim, et voici ce qu''il leur cria à haute voix: Ecoutez-moi, habitants de Sichem, et que Dieu vous écoute!
verses.am: ይህንም ነገር ለኢዮአታም በነገሩት ጊዜ፥ ሄዶ በገሪዛን ተራራ ራስ ላይ ቆመ፥ ድምፁንም አንሥቶ ጮኸ፥ እንዲህም አላቸው። የሴኬም ሰዎች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሰማችሁ ስሙኝ።

verses.en: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
verses.fr: Les arbres partirent pour aller oindre un roi et le mettre à leur tête. Ils dirent à l''olivier: Règne sur nous.
verses.am: አንድ ጊዜ ዛፎች በላያቸው ንጉሥ ሊያነግሡ ጌዱ፤ ወይራውንም። በእኛ ላይ ንገሥ አሉት።

verses.en: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.fr: Mais l''olivier leur répondit: Renoncerais-je à mon huile, qui m''assure les hommages de Dieu et des hommes, pour aller planer sur les arbres?
verses.am: ወይራው ግን። እግዚአብሔርና ሰዎች በእኔ የሚከበሩበትን ቅባቴን ትቼ በዛፎች ላይ እንድሰፍፍ ልሂድ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.fr: Et les arbres dirent au figuier: Viens, toi, règne sur nous.
verses.am: ዛፎችም በለሱን። መጥተህ በላያችን ንገሥ አሉት።

verses.en: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.fr: Mais le figuier leur répondit: Renoncerais-je à ma douceur et à mon excellent fruit, pour aller planer sur les arbres?
verses.am: በለሱ ግን። ጣፋጭነቴንና መልካሙን ፍሬዬን ትቼ በዛፎች ላይ እንድሰፍፍ ልሂድ? አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.fr: Et les arbres dirent à la vigne: Viens, toi, règne sur nous.
verses.am: ዛፎችም ውይኑን። መጥተህ በላያችን ንገሥ አሉት።

verses.en: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.fr: Mais la vigne leur répondit: Renoncerais-je à mon vin, qui réjouit Dieu et les hommes, pour aller planer sur les arbres?
verses.am: ወይኑም። እግዚአብሔርንና ሰውን ደስ የሚያሰኘውን የወይን ጠጄን ትቼ በዛፎች ላይ እንድሰፍፍ ልሂድ? አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.fr: Alors tous les arbres dirent au buisson d''épines: Viens, toi, règne sur nous.
verses.am: ዛፎችም ሁሉ እሾህን። መጥተህ በላያችን ንገሥ አሉት።

verses.en: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.fr: Et le buisson d''épines répondit aux arbres: Si c''est de bonne foi que vous voulez m''oindre pour votre roi, venez, réfugiez-vous sous mon ombrage; sinon, un feu sortira du buisson d''épines, et dévorera les cèdres du Liban.
verses.am: እሾሁም ዛፎችን። በእውነት እኔን በእናንተ ላይ ታነግሡኝ እንደ ሆነ ኑ ከጥላዬ በታች ተጠጉ። እንዲሁም ባይሆን እሳት ከእሾህ ይውጣ፥ የሊባኖስንም ዝግባ ያቃጥል አላቸው።

verses.en: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
verses.fr: Maintenant, est-ce de bonne foi et avec intégrité que vous avez agi en proclamant roi Abimélec? avez-vous eu de la bienveillance pour Jerubbaal et sa maison? l''avez-vous traité selon les services qu''il a rendus? -
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ አቤሜሌክን በማንገሣችሁ እውነትንና ቅንነትን አድርጋችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ ለይሩበኣልም ለቤቱም በጎ አድርጋችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ እንዳደረገውም መጠን ለእርሱ የተገባውን አድርጋችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥

verses.en: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
verses.fr: Car mon père a combattu pour vous, il a exposé sa vie, et il vous a délivrés de la main de Madian;
verses.am: አባቴ ስለ እናንተ ተጋድሎ ነበርና፥ ከምድያምም እጅ ሊያድናችሁ ነፍሱን ለሞት አሳልፎ ሰጥቶ ነበርና፥

verses.en: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
verses.fr: et vous, vous vous êtes levés contre la maison de mon père, vous avez tué ses fils, soixante-dix hommes, sur une même pierre, et vous avez proclamé roi sur les habitants de Sichem, Abimélec, fils de sa servante, parce qu''il est votre frère. -
verses.am: እናንተም ዛሬ በአባቴ ቤት ተነሥታችኋልና፥ ሰባ የሆኑትን ልጆቹንም በአንድ ድንጋይ ላይ አርዳችኋልና፥ ወንድማችሁም ስለ ሆነ የባሪያይቱን ልጅ አቤሜሌክን በሴኬም ሰዎች ላይ አንግሣችኋልና፥

verses.en: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
verses.fr: Si c''est de bonne foi et avec intégrité qu''en ce jour vous avez agi envers Jerubbaal et sa maison, eh bien! qu''Abimélec fasse votre joie, et que vous fassiez aussi la sienne!
verses.am: እንግዲህ ለይሩበኣልና ለቤቱ እውነትንና ቅንነትን ዛሬ አድርጋችሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ በአቤሜሌክ ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ እርሱ ደግሞ በእናንተ ደስ ይበለው፤

verses.en: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
verses.fr: Sinon, qu''un feu sorte d''Abimélec et dévore les habitants de Sichem et la maison de Millo, et qu''un feu sorte des habitants de Sichem et de la maison de Millo et dévore Abimélec!
verses.am: እንዲህ ባይሆን ግን ከአቤሜሌክ እሳት ይውጣ፥ የሴኬምንም ሰዎች ቤትሚሎንም ይብላ፤ ከሴኬምም ሰዎች ከቤትሚሎም እሳት ይውጣ፥ አቤሜሌክንም ይብላ።

verses.en: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.fr: Jotham se retira et prit la fuite; il s''en alla à Beer, où il demeura loin d''Abimélec, son frère.
verses.am: ኢዮአታምም ሸሽቶ አመለጠ፥ ወንድሙንም አቤሜሌክን ፈርቶ ወደ ብኤር ሄደ፥ በዚያም ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
verses.fr: Abimélec avait dominé trois ans sur Israël.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክም በእስራኤል ላይ ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
verses.fr: Alors Dieu envoya un mauvais esprit entre Abimélec et les habitants de Sichem, et les habitants de Sichem furent infidèles à Abimélec,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአቤሜሌክና በሴኬም ሰዎች መካከል ክፉን መንፈስ ሰደደ፤ የሴኬምም ሰዎች በአቤሜሌክ ላይ ተንኰል አደረጉ።

verses.en: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
verses.fr: afin que la violence commise sur les soixante-dix fils de Jerubbaal reçût son châtiment, et que leur sang retombât sur Abimélec, leur frère, qui les avait tués, et sur les habitants de Sichem, qui l''avaient aidé à tuer ses frères.
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው፥ በሰባ የይሩበኣል ልጆቹ ላይ የተደረገው ዓመፅ እንዲመጣ፥ ደማቸውም በገደላቸው በወንድማቸው በአቤሜሌክ ላይ፥ ወንድሞቹንም እንዲገድል እጆቹን ባጸኑአቸው በሴኬም ሰዎች ላይ እንዲሆን ነው።

verses.en: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
verses.fr: Les habitants de Sichem placèrent en embuscade contre lui, sur les sommets des montagnes, des gens qui dépouillaient tous ceux qui passaient près d''eux sur le chemin. Et cela fut rapporté à Abimélec.
verses.am: የሴኬምም ሰዎች በተራሮች ራስ ላይ ድብቅ ጦር አደረጉ፥ መንገድ ተላላፊዎችንም ሁሉ ይዘርፉ ነበር፤ አቤሜሌክም ይህን ወሬ ሰማ።

verses.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
verses.fr: Gaal, fils d''Ebed, vint avec ses frères, et ils passèrent à Sichem. Les habitants de Sichem eurent confiance en lui.
verses.am: የአቤድም ልጅ ገዓል ከወንድሞቹ ጋር መጥቶ ወደ ሴኬም ገባ፤ የሴኬምም ሰዎች ታመኑበት።

verses.en: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.fr: Ils sortirent dans la campagne, vendangèrent leurs vignes, foulèrent les raisins, et se livrèrent à des réjouissances; ils entrèrent dans la maison de leur dieu, ils mangèrent et burent, et ils maudirent Abimélec.
verses.am: ወደ እርሻውም ወጡ ወይናቸውንም ለቀሙ፥ ጠመቁትም፥ የደስታም በዓል አደረጉ፤ ወደ አምላካቸውም ቤት ገቡ፥ በሉም ጠጡም፥ አቤሜሌክንም ሰደቡ።

verses.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
verses.fr: Et Gaal, fils d''Ebed, disait: Qui est Abimélec, et qu''est Sichem, pour que nous servions Abimélec? N''est-il pas fils de Jerubbaal, et Zebul n''est-il pas son commissaire? Servez les hommes de Hamor, père de Sichem; mais nous, pourquoi servirions-nous Abimélec?
verses.am: የአቤድም ልጅ ገዓል። የምንገዛለት አቤሜሌክ ማን ነው? ሴኬምስ ምንድርነው? እርሱ የይሩብኣል ልጅ አይደለምን? ዜቡልም የእርሱ ሹም አይደለምን? ለሴኬም አባት ለኤሞር ሰዎች ተገዙ፤

verses.en: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
verses.fr: Oh! si j''étais le maître de ce peuple, je renverserais Abimélec. Et il disait d''Abimélec: Renforce ton armée, mets-toi en marche!
verses.am: ስለ ምንስ ለዚህ እንገዛለን? ይህ ሕዝብ ከእጄ በታች ቢሆን ኖሮ አቤሜሌክን አሳድደው ነበር አለ። አቤሜሌክንም። ሠራዊትህን አብዝተህ ና፥ ውጣ አለው።

verses.en: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.fr: Zebul, gouverneur de la ville, apprit ce que disait Gaal, fils d''Ebed, et sa colère s''enflamma.
verses.am: የከተማይቱ ገዥ ዜቡልም የአቤድን ልጅ የገዓልን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቈጣ።

verses.en: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
verses.fr: Il envoya secrètement des messagers à Abimélec, pour lui dire: Voici, Gaal, fils d''Ebed, et ses frères, sont venus à Sichem, et ils soulèvent la ville contre toi.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብሎ ወደ አቤሜሌክ በተንኰል መልክተኞች ላከ። እነሆ፥ የአቤድ ልጅ ገዓልና ወንድሞቹ ወደ ሴኬም መጥተዋል፥ በአንተም ላይ ከተማይቱን አሸፍተዋል።

verses.en: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
verses.fr: Maintenant, pars de nuit, toi et le peuple qui est avec toi, et mets-toi en embuscade dans la campagne.
verses.am: አሁንም አንተና ከአንተ ጋር ያሉት ሕዝብ በሌሊት ተነሡ፥ በሜዳም ሸምቁ፤

verses.en: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
verses.fr: Le matin, au lever du soleil, tu fondras avec impétuosité sur la ville. Et lorsque Gaal et le peuple qui est avec lui sortiront contre toi, tu lui feras ce que tes forces permettront.
verses.am: ነገም ፀሐይ በወጣች ጊዜ ማልደህ ተነሣ፥ በከተማይቱም ላይ ውደቅባት፤ እነሆም፥ እርሱና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉት ሕዝብ በአንተ ላይ በወጡ ጊዜ እጅህ እንዳገኘች አድርግበት።

verses.en: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.fr: Abimélec et tout le peuple qui était avec lui partirent de nuit, et ils se mirent en embuscade près de Sichem, divisés en quatre corps.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክና ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉ ሕዝብ ሁሉ በሌሊት ተነሡ፥ በሴኬምም አቅራቢያ በአራት ወገን ሸመቁበት።

verses.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
verses.fr: Gaal, fils d''Ebed, sortit, et il se tint à l''entrée de la porte de la ville. Abimélec et tout le peuple qui était avec lui se levèrent alors de l''embuscade.
verses.am: የአቤድም ልጅ ገዓል ወጥቶ በከተማይቱ በር አደባባይ ቆመ፤ አቤሜሌክና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉት ሕዝብ ከሸመቁበት ስፍራ ተነሱ።

verses.en: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
verses.fr: Gaal aperçut le peuple, et il dit à Zebul: Voici un peuple qui descend du sommet des montagnes. Zebul lui répondit: C''est l''ombre des montagnes que tu prends pour des hommes.
verses.am: ገዓልም ሕዝቡን ባየ ጊዜ ዜቡልን። እነሆ፥ ከተራሮች ራስ ሕዝብ ይወርዳል አለው። ዜቡልም። ሰዎች የሚመስለውን የተራሮችን ጥላ ታያለህ አለው።

verses.en: And Gaal spake again, and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
verses.fr: Gaal, reprenant la parole, dit: C''est bien un peuple qui descend des hauteurs du pays, et une troupe arrive par le chemin du chêne des devins.
verses.am: ገዓልም ደግሞ። እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ በምድር መካከል ይወርዳል፤ አንድም ወገን በምዖንኒም በአድባሩ ዛፍ መንገድ ይመጣል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
verses.fr: Zebul lui répondit: Où donc est ta bouche, toi qui disais: Qui est Abimélec, pour que nous le servions? N''est-ce point là le peuple que tu méprisais? Marche maintenant, livre-lui bataille!
verses.am: ዜቡልም። እንገዛለት ዘንድ አቤሜሌክ ማን ነው? ያልህበት አፍህ አሁን የት አለ? ይህ የናቅኸው ሕዝብ አይደለምን? አሁንም ወጥተህ ከእነርሱ ጋር ተዋጋ አለው።

verses.en: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.fr: Gaal s''avança à la tête des habitants de Sichem, et livra bataille à Abimélec.
verses.am: ገዓልም በሴኬም ሰዎች ፊት ወጣ፥ ከአቤሜሌክም ጋር ተዋጋ።

verses.en: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.fr: Poursuivi par Abimélec, il prit la fuite devant lui, et beaucoup d''hommes tombèrent morts jusqu''à l''entrée de la porte.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክም አሳደደው፤ በፊቱም ሸሸ፥ እስከ በሩም አደባባይ ድረስ ብዙዎች ተጐድተው ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.fr: Abimélec s''arrêta à Aruma. Et Zebul chassa Gaal et ses frères, qui ne purent rester à Sichem.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክም በአሩማ ተቀመጠ፤ ዜቡልም ገዓልንና ወንድሞቹን በሴኬም እንዳይኖሩ አሳደዳቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, le peuple sortit dans la campagne. Abimélec, qui en fut informé,
verses.am: በነጋውም ሕዝቡ ወደ እርሻ ወጡ፤ አቤሜሌክም ሰማ።

verses.en: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.fr: prit sa troupe, la partagea en trois corps, et se mit en embuscade dans la campagne. Ayant vu que le peuple sortait de la ville, il se leva contre eux, et les battit.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ወስዶ በሦስት ወገን ከፈላቸው፥ በሜዳም ሸመቀ፤ ተመለከተም፥ እነሆም፥ ሕዝቡ ከከተማ ወጡ፥ ተነሣባቸውም መታቸውም።

verses.en: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
verses.fr: Abimélec et les corps qui étaient avec lui se portèrent en avant, et se placèrent à l''entrée de la porte de la ville; deux de ces corps se jetèrent sur tous ceux qui étaient dans la campagne, et les battirent.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክም ከእርሱም ጋር ያሉት ወገኖች ተጣደፉ በከተማይቱም በር አደባባይ ቆሙ፤ ሁለቱም ወገኖች በእርሻው ውስጥ በነበሩት ሁሉ ላይ ሮጡባቸው፥ መቱአቸውም።

verses.en: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.fr: Abimélec attaqua la ville pendant toute la journée; il s''en empara, et tua le peuple qui s''y trouvait. Puis il rasa la ville, et y sema du sel.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክም በዚያ ቀን ሁሉ ከከተማይቱ ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ከተማይቱንም ይዞ በእርሷ የነበሩትን ሕዝብ ገደለ፤ ከተማይቱንም አፈረሰ፥ ጨውም ዘራባት።

verses.en: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
verses.fr: A cette nouvelle, tous les habitants de la tour de Sichem se rendirent dans la forteresse de la maison du dieu Berith.
verses.am: በሴኬምም ግንብ ውስጥ የነበሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ወደ ኤልብሪት ቤት ወደ ምሽጉ ውስጥ ገቡ።

verses.en: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.fr: On avertit Abimélec que tous les habitants de la tour de Sichem s''y étaient rassemblés.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክም በሴኬም ግንብ ውስጥ ያሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ አንድ ሆነው እንደ ተሰበሰቡ ሰማ።

verses.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
verses.fr: Alors Abimélec monta sur la montagne de Tsalmon, lui et tout le peuple qui était avec lui. Il prit en main une hache, coupa une branche d''arbre, l''enleva et la mit sur son épaule. Ensuite il dit au peuple qui était avec lui: Vous avez vu ce que j''ai fait, hâtez-vous de faire comme moi.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክና ከእርሱ ጋር ያሉትም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ ሰልሞን ተራራ ወጡ፤ አቤሜሌክም በእጁ መጥረቢያ ወስዶ የዛፉን ቅርንጫፍ ቈረጠ፥ አንሥቶም በጫንቃው ላይ አደረገው፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ለነበሩት ሕዝብ። እኔ ሳደርግ ያያችሁትን፥ እናንተም ፈጥናችሁ እኔ እንዳደረግሁ አድርጉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.fr: Et ils coupèrent chacun une branche, et suivirent Abimélec; ils placèrent les branches contre la forteresse, et l''incendièrent avec ceux qui y étaient. Ainsi périrent tous les gens de la tour de Sichem, au nombre d''environ mille, hommes et femmes.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እንዲሁ እያንዳንዳቸው የዛፉን ቅርንጫፎች ቈረጡ፥ አቤሜሌክንም ተከትለው በምሽጉ ዙሪያ አኖሩአቸው፥ ምሽጉንም በላያቸው አቃጠሉት፤ የሴኬምም ግንብ ሰዎች ሁሉ ደግሞ አንድ ሺህ የሚያህሉ ወንድና ሴት ሞቱ።

verses.en: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.fr: Abimélec marcha contre Thébets. Il assiégea Thébets, et s''en empara.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክም ወደ ቴቤስ መጣ፥ ቴቤስንም ከብቦ ያዛት።

verses.en: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
verses.fr: Il y avait au milieu de la ville une forte tour, où se réfugièrent tous les habitants de la ville, hommes et femmes; ils fermèrent sur eux, et montèrent sur le toit de la tour.
verses.am: በከተማይቱም ውስጥ ብርቱ ግንብ ነበረ፥ የከተማይቱም ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ወንዱና ሴቱ ሁሉ፥ ወደዚያ ሸሹ፤ ደጁንም በኋላቸው ዘጉ፥ ወደ ግንቡም ሰገነት ላይ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.fr: Abimélec parvint jusqu''à la tour; il l''attaqua, et s''approcha de la porte pour y mettre le feu.
verses.am: አቤሜሌክም ወደ ግንቡ ቀርቦ ይዋጋ ነበር፥ በእሳትም ሊያቃጥለው ወደ ግንቡ ደጅ ደረሰ።

verses.en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
verses.fr: Alors une femme lança sur la tête d''Abimélec un morceau de meule de moulin, et lui brisa le crâne.
verses.am: አንዲትም ሴት በአቤሜሌክ ራስ ላይ የወፍጮ መጅ ጣለችበት፥ አናቱንም ሰበረችው።

verses.en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A women slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.fr: Aussitôt il appela le jeune homme qui portait ses armes, et lui dit: Tire ton épée, et donne-moi la mort, de peur qu''on ne dise de moi: C''est une femme qui l''a tué. Le jeune homme le perça, et il mourut.
verses.am: እርሱም ፈጥኖ ጋሻ ዣግሬውን ጠርቶ። እኔን። ሴት ገደለችው እንዳይሉ ሰይፍህን መዝዘህ ግደለኝ አለው፤ ጕልማሳውም ወጋው፥ ሞተም።

verses.en: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.fr: Quand les hommes d''Israël virent qu''Abimélec était mort, ils s''en allèrent chacun chez soi.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች አቤሜሌክ እንደ ሞተ ባዩ ጊዜ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ስፍራው ተመለሰ።

verses.en: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
verses.fr: Ainsi Dieu fit retomber sur Abimélec le mal qu''il avait fait à son père, en tuant ses soixante-dix frères,
verses.am: እንዲሁ ሰባ ወንድሞቹን በመግደል አቤሜሌክ በአባቱ ላይ ያደረገውን ክፋት እግዚአብሔር መለሰበት።

verses.en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.fr: et Dieu fit retomber sur la tête des gens de Sichem tout le mal qu''ils avaient fait. Ainsi s''accomplit sur eux la malédiction de Jotham, fils de Jerubbaal.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የሴኬምን ሰዎች ክፋት ሁሉ በራሳቸው ላይ መለሰባቸው፤ የይሩበኣልም ልጅ የኢዮአታም እርግማን ደረሰባቸው።

verses.en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
verses.fr: Après Abimélec, Thola, fils de Pua, fils de Dodo, homme d''Issacar, se leva pour délivrer Israël; il habitait à Schamir, dans la montagne d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: ከአቤሜሌክም በኋላ ከይሳኮር ነገድ የሆነ የዱዲ ልጅ የፎሖ ልጅ ቶላ እስራኤልን ለማዳን ተነሣ፤ በተራራማውም በኤፍሬም አገር ባለችው በሳምር ተቀምጦ ነበር።

verses.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.fr: Il fut juge en Israël pendant vingt-trois ans; puis il mourut, et fut enterré à Schamir.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ላይ ሀያ ሦስት ዓመት ፈረደ፤ ሞተም፥ በሳምርም ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.fr: Après lui, se leva Jaïr, le Galaadite, qui fut juge en Israël pendant vingt-deux ans.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ገለዓዳዊው ኢያዕር ተነሣ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.en: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.fr: Il avait trente fils, qui montaient sur trente ânons, et qui possédaient trente villes, appelées encore aujourd''hui bourgs de Jaïr, et situées dans le pays de Galaad.
verses.am: በሠላሳ የአህያ ግልገሎች ይቀመጡ የነበሩ ሠላሳ ልጆችም ነበሩት፤ ለእነርሱም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የኢያዕር መንደሮች የተባሉ በገለዓድ ምድር ያሉ ሠላሳ ከተሞች ነበሩአቸው።

verses.en: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
verses.fr: Et Jaïr mourut, et fut enterré à Kamon.
verses.am: ኢያዕርም ሞተ፥ በቃሞንም ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the Lord, and served not him.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent encore ce qui déplaît à l''Eternel; ils servirent les Baals et les Astartés, les dieux de Syrie, les dieux de Sidon, les dieux de Moab, les dieux des fils d''Ammon, et les dieux des Philistins, et ils abandonnèrent l''Eternel et ne le servirent plus.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ገና ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ በኣሊምንና አስታሮትን የሶርያንም አማልክት፥ የሲዶናንም አማልክት፥ የሞዓብንም አማልክት፥ የአሞንንም ልጆች አማልክት፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንንም አማልክት አመለኩ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ተዉ፥ አላመለኩትምም።

verses.en: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Israël, et il les vendit entre les mains des Philistins et entre les mains des fils d''Ammon.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ፥ በፍልስጥኤማውያንና በአሞን ልጆች እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.fr: Ils opprimèrent et écrasèrent les enfants d''Israël cette année-là, et pendant dix-huit ans tous les enfants d''Israël qui étaient de l''autre côté du Jourdain dans le pays des Amoréens en Galaad.
verses.am: በዚያም ዓመት የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሥቃይ አበዙባቸው፤ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በአሞራውያን አገር በገለዓድ ውስጥ ያሉትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሁሉ አሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ተጋፉአቸው።

verses.en: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Ammon passèrent le Jourdain pour combattre aussi contre Juda, contre Benjamin et contre la maison d''Ephraïm. Et Israël fut dans une grande détresse.
verses.am: የአሞንም ልጆች ከይሁዳ ከብንያምና ከኤፍሬም ቤት ጋር ደግሞ ሊዋጋ ዮርዳኖስን ተሻገሩ፤ እስራኤልም እጅግ ተጨነቁ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël crièrent à l''Eternel, en disant: Nous avons péché contre toi, car nous avons abandonné notre Dieu et nous avons servi les Baals.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች። አምላካችንን ትተን በኣሊምን አምልከናልና አንተን በድለናል ብለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit aux enfants d''Israël: Ne vous ai-je pas délivrés des Egyptiens, des Amoréens, des fils d''Ammon, des Philistins?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ልጆች አላቸው። ግብፃውያን፥ አሞራውያንም፥ የአሞንም ልጆች፥

verses.en: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
verses.fr: Et lorsque les Sidoniens, Amalek et Maon, vous opprimèrent, et que vous criâtes à moi, ne vous ai-je pas délivrés de leurs mains?
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም፥ ሲዶናውያንም፥ አማሌቃውያንም፥ ማዖናውያንም አላስጨነቋችሁምን? ወደ እኔም ጮኻችሁ፥ እኔም ከእጃቸው አዳንኋችሁ።

verses.en: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.fr: Mais vous, vous m''avez abandonné, et vous avez servi d''autres dieux. C''est pourquoi je ne vous délivrerai plus.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ተዋችሁኝ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አመለካችሁ፤ ስለዚህም ደግሞ አላድናችሁም።

verses.en: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
verses.fr: Allez, invoquez les dieux que vous avez choisis; qu''ils vous délivrent au temps de votre détresse!
verses.am: ሄዳችሁም የመረጣችኋቸውን አማልክት ጥሩ፤ እነርሱም በመከራችሁ ጊዜ ያድኑአችሁ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel said unto the Lord, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël dirent à l''Eternel: Nous avons péché; traite-nous comme il te plaira. Seulement, daigne nous délivrer aujourd''hui!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን። እኛ ኃጢአትን ሠርተናል፤ አንተ ደስ የሚያሰኝህን አድርግብን ዛሬ ግን፥ እባክህ፥ አድነን አሉት።

verses.en: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the Lord: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.fr: Et ils ôtèrent les dieux étrangers du milieu d''eux, et servirent l''Eternel, qui fut touché des maux d''Israël.
verses.am: ሌሎችንም አማልክት ከመካከላቸው አስወገዱ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም አመለኩ፤ ነፍሱም ስለ እስራኤል ጕስቍልና አዘነች።

verses.en: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Ammon se rassemblèrent et campèrent en Galaad, et les enfants d''Israël se rassemblèrent et campèrent à Mitspa.
verses.am: የአሞንም ልጆች ተሰብስበው በገለዓድ ሰፈሩ። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተሰብስበው በምጽጳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.fr: Le peuple, les chefs de Galaad se dirent l''un à l''autre: Quel est l''homme qui commencera l''attaque contre les fils d''Ammon? Il sera chef de tous les habitants de Galaad.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም፥ የገለዓድ አለቆች፥ እርስ በእርሳቸው። ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር መዋጋት የሚጀምር ማን ነው? እርሱ በገለዓድ ሰዎች ሁሉ ላይ አለቃ ይሆናል አሉ። a

verses.en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
verses.fr: Jephthé, le Galaadite, était un vaillant héros. Il était fils d''une femme prostituée; et c''est Galaad qui avait engendré Jephthé.
verses.am: ገለዓዳዊውም ዮፍታሔ ጽኑዕ ኃያል ሰው የጋለሞታ ሴትም ልጅ ነበረ። ገለዓድም ዮፍታሔን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.
verses.fr: La femme de Galaad lui enfanta des fils, qui, devenus grands, chassèrent Jephthé, et lui dirent: Tu n''hériteras pas dans la maison de notre père, car tu es fils d''une autre femme.
verses.am: የገለዓድም ሚስት ወንዶች ልጆችን ወለደችለት፤ ልጆችዋም ባደጉ ጊዜ ዮፍታሔን። የልዩ ሴት ልጅ ነህና በአባታችን ቤት አትወርስም ብለው አሳደዱት።

verses.en: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
verses.fr: Et Jephthé s''enfuit loin de ses frères, et il habita dans le pays de Tob. Des gens de rien se rassemblèrent auprès de Jephthé, et ils faisaient avec lui des excursions.
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም ከወንድሞቹ ፊት ሸሽቶ በጦብ ምድር ተቀመጠ፤ ምናምንቴዎችም ሰዎች ተሰብስበው ዮፍታሔን ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.fr: Quelque temps après, les fils d''Ammon firent la guerre à Israël.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወራት በኋላ የአሞን ልጆች ከእስራኤል ጋር ይዋጉ ነበር።

verses.en: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
verses.fr: Et comme les fils d''Ammon faisaient la guerre à Israël, les anciens de Galaad allèrent chercher Jephthé au pays de Tob.
verses.am: የአሞንም ልጆች ከእስራኤል ጋር በተዋጉ ጊዜ የገለዓድ ሽማግሌዎች ዮፍታሔን ከጦብ ምድር ለማምጣት ሄዱ።

verses.en: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
verses.fr: Ils dirent à Jephthé: Viens, tu seras notre chef, et nous combattrons les fils d''Ammon.
verses.am: ዮፍታሔንም። ና፥ ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር እንድንዋጋ አለቃችን ሁን አሉት።

verses.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
verses.fr: Jephthé répondit aux anciens de Galaad: N''avez-vous pas eu de la haine pour moi, et ne m''avez-vous pas chassé de la maison de mon père? Pourquoi venez-vous à moi maintenant que vous êtes dans la détresse?
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም የገለዓድን ሽማግሌዎች። የጠላችሁኝ ከአባቴም ቤት ያሳደዳችሁኝ እናንተ አይደላችሁምን? አሁን በተጨነቃችሁ ጊዜ ለምን ወደ እኔ መጣችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.fr: Les anciens de Galaad dirent à Jephthé: Nous revenons à toi maintenant, afin que tu marches avec nous, que tu combattes les fils d''Ammon, et que tu sois notre chef, celui de tous les habitants de Galaad.
verses.am: የገለዓድም ሽማግሌዎች ዮፍታሔን። ከእኛ ጋር እንድትወጣ፥ ከአሞንም ልጆች ጋር እንድትዋጋ፥ ስለዚህ አሁን ወደ አንተ ተመልሰን መጣን፤ በገለዓድም ሰዎች ሁሉ ላይ አለቃችን ትሆናለህ አሉት።

verses.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the Lord deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
verses.fr: Jephthé répondit aux anciens de Galaad: Si vous me ramenez pour combattre les fils d''Ammon, et que l''Eternel les livre devant moi, je serai votre chef.
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም የገለዓድን ሽማግሌዎች። ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር ለመዋጋት ወደ አገሬ ብትመልሱኝ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእጄ አሳልፎ ቢሰጣቸው፥ እኔ አለቃችሁ እሆናለሁን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The Lord be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
verses.fr: Les anciens de Galaad dirent à Jephthé: Que l''Eternel nous entende, et qu''il juge, si nous ne faisons pas ce que tu dis.
verses.am: የገለዓድም ሽማግሌዎች ዮፍታሔን። እግዚአብሔር በመካከላችን ምስክር ይሁን፤ በእርግጥ እንደ ቃልህ እናደርጋለን አሉት።

verses.en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the Lord in Mizpeh.
verses.fr: Et Jephthé partit avec les anciens de Galaad. Le peuple le mit à sa tête et l''établit comme chef, et Jephthé répéta devant l''Eternel, à Mitspa, toutes les paroles qu''il avait prononcées.
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም ከገለዓድ ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ሄደ፥ ሕዝቡም በላያቸው ራስና አለቃ አደረጉት፤ ዮፍታሔም ቃሉን ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በምጽጳ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
verses.fr: Jephthé envoya des messagers au roi des fils d''Ammon, pour lui dire: Qu''y a-t-il entre moi et toi, que tu viennes contre moi pour faire la guerre à mon pays?
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም ወደ አሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ። አገሬን ለመውጋት ወደ እኔ የምትመጣ አንተ ከእኔ ጋር ምን አለህ? ብሎ መልክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
verses.fr: Le roi des fils d''Ammon répondit aux messagers de Jephthé: C''est qu''Israël, quand il est monté d''Egypte, s''est emparé de mon pays, depuis l''Arnon jusqu''au Jabbok et au Jourdain. Rends-le maintenant de bon gré.
verses.am: የአሞንም ልጆች ንጉሥ የዮፍታሔን መልክተኞች። እስራኤል ከግብፅ በወጣ ጊዜ ከአርኖን ጀምሮ እስከ ያቦቅና እስከ ዮርዳኖስ ድረስ ምድሬን ስለ ወሰደ ነው፤ አሁንም በሰላም መልሱልኝ ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
verses.fr: Jephthé envoya de nouveau des messagers au roi des fils d''Ammon,
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም ወደ አሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ መልክተኞችን እንደ ገና ላከ፥

verses.en: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
verses.fr: pour lui dire: Ainsi parle Jephthé: Israël ne s''est point emparé du pays de Moab, ni du pays des fils d''Ammon.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለው። ዮፍታሔ እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤል የሞዓብን ምድር የአሞንንም ልጆች ምድር አልወሰደም፤

verses.en: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.fr: Car lorsque Israël est monté d''Egypte, il a marché dans le désert jusqu''à la mer Rouge, et il est arrivé à Kadès.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከግብፅ በወጣ ጊዜ፥ እስራኤልም በምድረ በዳ በኩል ወደ ኤርትራ ባሕር በሄደ ጊዜ፥ ወደ ቃዴስም በደረሰ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
verses.fr: Alors Israël envoya des messagers au roi d''Edom, pour lui dire: Laisse-moi passer par ton pays. Mais le roi d''Edom n''y consentit pas. Il en envoya aussi au roi de Moab, qui refusa. Et Israël resta à Kadès.
verses.am: እስራኤል ወደ ኤዶምያስ ንጉሥ። በምድርህ እንዳልፍ፥ እባክህ፥ ፍቀድልኝ ብሎ መልክተኞችን ላከ፤ የኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ አልሰማም። እንዲሁም ወደ ሞዓብ ንጉሥ ላከ፥ እርሱም አልፈቀደም።

verses.en: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.fr: Puis il marcha par le désert, tourna le pays d''Edom et le pays de Moab, et vint à l''orient du pays de Moab; ils campèrent au delà de l''Arnon, sans entrer sur le territoire de Moab, car l''Arnon est la frontière de Moab.
verses.am: እስራኤልም በቃዴስ ተቀመጠ። በምድረ በዳም በኩል ሄዱ፥ የኤዶምያስንና የሞዓብንም ምድር ዞሩ፤ ከሞዓብ ምድርም በምሥራቅ በኩል መጡ በአርኖንም ማዶ ሰፈሩ፤ አርኖንም የሞዓብ ድንበር ነበረና የሞዓብን ድንበር አላለፉም።

verses.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
verses.fr: Israël envoya des messagers à Sihon, roi des Amoréens, roi de Hesbon, et Israël lui dit: Laisse-nous passer par ton pays jusqu''au lieu où nous allons.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ወደ አሞራዊው ወደ ሐሴቦን ንጉሥ ወደ ሴዎን መልክተኞችን ላከ፤ እስራኤልም። በምድርህ በኩል ወደ ስፍራችን፥ እባክህ፥ አሳልፈን አለው።

verses.en: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.fr: Mais Sihon n''eut pas assez confiance en Israël pour le laisser passer sur son territoire; il rassembla tout son peuple, campa à Jahats, et combattit Israël.
verses.am: ሴዎንም እስራኤል በድንበሩ እንዲያልፍ አላመነውም ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሴዎን ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ በያሀጽም ሰፈረ፥ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ተዋጋ።

verses.en: And the Lord God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, livra Sihon et tout son peuple entre les mains d''Israël, qui les battit. Israël s''empara de tout le pays des Amoréens établis dans cette contrée.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ሴዎንና ሕዝቡን ሁሉ በእስራኤል እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠ፥ መቱአቸውም፤ እስራኤልም በዚያ ምድር ተቀምጠው የነበሩትን የአሞራውያንን ምድር ሁሉ ወረሰ።

verses.en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
verses.fr: Ils s''emparèrent de tout le territoire des Amoréens, depuis l''Arnon jusqu''au Jabbok, et depuis le désert jusqu''au Jourdain.
verses.am: ከአርኖንም እስከ ያቦቅ ድረስ ከምድረ በዳውም እስከ ዮርዳኖስ ድረስ የአሞራውያንን ምድር ሁሉ ወረሱ።

verses.en: So now the Lord God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
verses.fr: Et maintenant que l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, a chassé les Amoréens devant son peuple d''Israël, est-ce toi qui aurais la possession de leur pays?
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቡ ከእስራኤል ፊት አሞራውያንን አስወገደ፤ አንተም ምድሩን ትወርሳለህን?

verses.en: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the Lord our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
verses.fr: Ce que ton dieu Kemosch te donne à posséder, ne le posséderais-tu pas? Et tout ce que l''Eternel, notre Dieu, a mis en notre possession devant nous, nous ne le posséderions pas!
verses.am: አምላክህ ካሞሽ የሚሰጥህን አትወርስምን? እኛም አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ከፊታችን ያስወጣቸውን የእነርሱን ምድር እንወርሳለን።

verses.en: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
verses.fr: Vaux-tu donc mieux que Balak, fils de Tsippor, roi de Moab? A-t-il contesté avec Israël, ou lui a-t-il fait la guerre?
verses.am: ወይስ ከሞዓብ ንጉሥ ከሴፎር ልጅ ከባላቅ አንተ ትሻላለህን? በውኑ እርሱ እስራኤልን ከቶ ተጣላውን? ወይስ ተዋጋውን?

verses.en: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?
verses.fr: Voilà trois cents ans qu''Israël habite à Hesbon et dans les villes de son ressort, à Aroër et dans les villes de son ressort, et dans toutes les villes qui sont sur les bords de l''Arnon: pourquoi ne les lui avez-vous pas enlevées pendant ce temps-là?
verses.am: እስራኤልም በሐሴቦንና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በአሮዔርና በመንደሮችዋ፥ በአርኖንም አቅራቢያ ባሉት ከተሞች ሁሉ ሦስት መቶ ዓመት ተቀምጦ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ በዚያ ዘመን ስለ ምን አልወሰዳችኋቸውም ነበር?

verses.en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the Lord the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
verses.fr: Je ne t''ai point offensé, et tu agis mal avec moi en me faisant la guerre. Que l''Eternel, le juge, soit aujourd''hui juge entre les enfants d''Israël et les fils d''Ammon!
verses.am: እኔ አልበደልሁህም፥ አንተ ግን ከእኔ ጋር እየተዋጋህ በድለኸኛል፤ ፈራጁ እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ልጆችና በአሞን ልጆች መካከል ዛሬ ይፍረድ።

verses.en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
verses.fr: Le roi des fils d''Ammon n''écouta point les paroles que Jephthé lui fit dire.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዮፍታሔ የላከበትን ቃል የአሞን ልጆች ንጉሥ አልሰማም።

verses.en: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
verses.fr: L''esprit de l''Eternel fut sur Jephthé. Il traversa Galaad et Manassé; il passa à Mitspé de Galaad; et de Mitspé de Galaad, il marcha contre les fils d''Ammon.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በዮፍታሔ ላይ መጣ፤ እርሱም ገለዓድንና ምናሴን አለፈ፥ በገለዓድም ያለውን ምጽጳን አለፈ፥ ከምጽጳም ወደ አሞን ልጆች አለፈ።

verses.en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the Lord, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
verses.fr: Jephthé fit un voeu à l''Eternel, et dit: Si tu livres entre mes mains les fils d''Ammon,
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም። በእውነት የአሞንን ልጆች በእጄ አሳልፈህ ብትሰጠኝ፥

verses.en: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the Lord's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
verses.fr: quiconque sortira des portes de ma maison au-devant de moi, à mon heureux retour de chez les fils d''Ammon, sera consacré à l''Eternel, et je l''offrirai en holocauste.
verses.am: ከአሞን ልጆች ዘንድ በደኅና በተመለስሁ ጊዜ፥ ሊገናኘኝ ከቤቴ ደጅ የሚወጣው ማንኛውም ለእግዚአብሔር ይሆናል፤ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አቀርበዋለሁ ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት ተሳለ።

verses.en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the Lord delivered them into his hands.
verses.fr: Jephthé marcha contre les fils d''Ammon, et l''Eternel les livra entre ses mains.
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም ሊዋጋቸው ወደ አሞን ልጆች አለፈ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Il leur fit éprouver une très grande défaite, depuis Aroër jusque vers Minnith, espace qui renfermait vingt villes, et jusqu''à Abel-Keramim. Et les fils d''Ammon furent humiliés devant les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ከአሮዔርም እስከ ሚኒትና እስከ አቤልክራሚም ድረስ ሀያ ከተሞችን በታላቅ አገዳደል መታቸው። የአሞንም ልጆች በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ተዋረዱ።

verses.en: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.fr: Jephthé retourna dans sa maison à Mitspa. Et voici, sa fille sortit au-devant de lui avec des tambourins et des danses. C''était son unique enfant; il n''avait point de fils et point d''autre fille.
verses.am: ዮፍታሄም ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ምጽጳ መጣ፥ እነሆም ልጁ ከበሮ ይዛ እየዘፈነች ልትገናኘው ወጣች፤ ለእርሱም አንዲት ብቻ ነበረች፤ ከእርስዋም በቀር ወንድ ወይም ሴት ሌላ ልጅ አልነበረውም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the Lord, and I cannot go back.
verses.fr: Dès qu''il la vit, il déchira ses vêtements, et dit: Ah! ma fille! tu me jettes dans l''abattement, tu es au nombre de ceux qui me troublent! J''ai fait un voeu à l''Eternel, et je ne puis le révoquer.
verses.am: እርስዋንም ባየ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀድዶ። አወይ ልጄ ሆይ! ወደ እግዚአብሔር አፌን ከፍቻለሁና፥ ከዚያውም እመለስ ዘንድ አልችልምና በጣም አዋረድሽኝ አስጨነቅሽኝም አላት።

verses.en: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the Lord, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the Lord hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
verses.fr: Elle lui dit: Mon père, si tu as fait un voeu à l''Eternel, traite-moi selon ce qui est sorti de ta bouche, maintenant que l''Eternel t''a vengé de tes ennemis, des fils d''Ammon.
verses.am: እርስዋም። አባቴ ሆይ፥ አፍህን ለእግዚአብሔር ከከፈትህ፥ እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶችህ በአሞን ልጆች ላይ ተበቅሎልሃልና በአፍህ እንደ ተናገርህ አድርግብኝ አለችው።

verses.en: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
verses.fr: Et elle dit à son père: Que ceci me soit accordé: laisse-moi libre pendant deux mois! Je m''en irai, je descendrai dans les montagnes, et je pleurerai ma virginité avec mes compagnes.
verses.am: አባትዋንም። ይህ ነገር ይደረግልኝ፤ ከዚህ ሄጄ በተራሮች ላይ እንድወጣና እንድወርድ፥ ከባልንጀሮቼም ጋር ለድንግልናዬ እንዳለቅስ ሁለት ወር አሰናብተኝ አለችው።

verses.en: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Va! Et il la laissa libre pour deux mois. Elle s''en alla avec ses compagnes, et elle pleura sa virginité sur les montagnes.
verses.am: እርሱም። ሂጂ አለ። ሁለት ወርም አሰናበታት፤ ከባልንጀሮችዋም ጋር ሄደች፥ በተራሮችም ላይ ለድንግልናዋ አለቀሰች።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
verses.fr: Au bout des deux mois, elle revint vers son père, et il accomplit sur elle le voeu qu''il avait fait. Elle n''avait point connu d''homme. Dès lors s''établit en Israël la coutume
verses.am: ሁለትም ወር ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ወደ አባትዋ ተመለሰች፥ እንደ ተሳለውም ስእለት አደረገባት፤ እርስዋም ወንድ አላወቀችም ነበር።

verses.en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
verses.fr: que tous les ans les filles d''Israël s''en vont célébrer la fille de Jephthé, le Galaadite, quatre jours par année.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሴቶች ልጆች በዓመት በዓመቱ እየሄዱ የገለዓዳዊውን የዮፍታሔን ልጅ በዓመት አራት ቀን ሙሾ እንዲያወጡ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ልማድ ሆነ።

verses.en: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
verses.fr: Les hommes d''Ephraïm se rassemblèrent, partirent pour le nord, et dirent à Jephthé: Pourquoi es-tu allé combattre les fils d''Ammon sans nous avoir appelés à marcher avec toi? Nous voulons incendier ta maison et te brûler avec elle.
verses.am: የኤፍሬም ሰዎች ተሰበሰቡ፥ ወደ ጻፎንም ተሻግረው ዮፍታሔን። ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር ለመዋጋት ስታልፍ ከአንተ ጋር እንድንሄድ ስለ ምን አልጠራኸንም? ቤትህን በአንተ ላይ በእሳት እናቃጥለዋለን አሉት።

verses.en: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
verses.fr: Jephthé leur répondit: Nous avons eu de grandes contestations, moi et mon peuple, avec les fils d''Ammon; et quand je vous ai appelés, vous ne m''avez pas délivré de leurs mains.
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም። ከአሞን ልጆች ጋር ለእኔና ለሕዝቤ ጽኑ ጠብ ነበረን፤ በጠራኋችሁም ጊዜ ከእጃቸው አላዳናችሁኝም።

verses.en: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the Lord delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
verses.fr: Voyant que tu ne venais pas à mon secours, j''ai exposé ma vie, et j''ai marché contre les fils d''Ammon. L''Eternel les a livrés entre mes mains. Pourquoi donc aujourd''hui montez-vous contre moi pour me faire la guerre?
verses.am: እንዳላዳናችሁኝም ባየሁ ጊዜ ነፍሴን በእጄ አድርጌ በአሞን ልጆች ላይ አለፍሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእጄ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ ለምንስ ዛሬ ልትወጉኝ ወደ እኔ መጣችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
verses.fr: Jephthé rassembla tous les hommes de Galaad, et livra bataille à Ephraïm. Les hommes de Galaad battirent Ephraïm, parce que les Ephraïmites disaient: Vous êtes des fugitifs d''Ephraïm! Galaad est au milieu d''Ephraïm, au milieu de Manassé!
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም የገለዓድን ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ ከኤፍሬምም ጋር ተዋጋ፤ ኤፍሬምም። ገለዓዳውያን ሆይ፥ እናንተ በኤፍሬምና በምናሴ መካከል የተቀመጣችሁት ከኤፍሬም ሸሽታችሁ ነው ስላሉ የገለዓድ ሰዎች ኤፍሬምን መቱ።

verses.en: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
verses.fr: Galaad s''empara des gués du Jourdain du côté d''Ephraïm. Et quand l''un des fuyards d''Ephraïm disait: Laissez-moi passer! les hommes de Galaad lui demandaient: Es-tu Ephraïmite? Il répondait: Non.
verses.am: ገለዓዳውያንም ኤፍሬም የሚያልፍበትን የዮርዳኖስን መሻገሪያ ያዙባቸው፤ የሸሸም የኤፍሬም ሰው። ልለፍ ባለ ጊዜ፥ የገለዓድ ሰዎች። አንተ ኤፍሬማዊ ነህን? አሉት፤ እርሱም። አይደለሁም ቢል፥

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
verses.fr: Ils lui disaient alors: Hé bien, dis Schibboleth. Et il disait Sibboleth, car il ne pouvait pas bien prononcer. Sur quoi les hommes de Galaad le saisissaient, et l''égorgeaient près des gués du Jourdain. Il périt en ce temps-là quarante-deux mille hommes d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: እነርሱ። አሁን ሺቦሌት በል አሉት፤ እርሱም አጥርቶ መናገር አልቻለምና። ሲቦሌት አለ፤ ይዘውም በዮርዳኖስ መሻገሪያ አረዱት፤ በዚያም ጊዜ ከኤፍሬም አርባ ሁለት ሺህ ሰዎች ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
verses.fr: Jephthé fut juge en Israël pendant six ans; puis Jephthé, le Galaadite, mourut, et fut enterré dans l''une des villes de Galaad.
verses.am: ዮፍታሔም በእስራኤል ላይ ስድስት ዓመት ፈረደ። ገለዓዳዊውም ዮፍታሔ ሞተ፥ ከገለዓድም ከተሞች በአንዲቱ ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
verses.fr: Après lui, Ibtsan de Bethléhem fut juge en Israël.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የቤተ ልሔሙ ኢብጻን በእስራኤል ላይ ፈራጅ ሆነ።

verses.en: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
verses.fr: Il eut trente fils, il maria trente filles au dehors, et il fit venir pour ses fils trente filles du dehors. Il fut juge en Israël pendant sept ans;
verses.am: ሠላሳም ወንዶች ልጆችና ሠላሳ ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ሠላሳ ሴቶች ልጆቹንም ወደ ውጭ አገር ዳረ፤ ለወንዶች ልጆቹም ከውጭ አገር ሴቶች ልጆችን አመጣ። በእስራኤልም ላይ ሰባት ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.en: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.
verses.fr: puis Ibtsan mourut, et fut enterré à Bethléhem.
verses.am: ኢብጻንም ሞተ፥ በቤተ ልሔምም ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
verses.fr: Après lui, Elon de Zabulon fut juge en Israël. Il fut juge en Israël pendant dix ans;
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ዛብሎናዊው ኤሎም በእስራኤል ላይ ፈራጅ ሆነ፤ እርሱም በእስራኤል ላይ አሥር ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.en: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
verses.fr: puis Elon de Zabulon mourut, et fut enterré à Ajalon, dans le pays de Zabulon.
verses.am: ዛብሎናዊውም ኤሎም ሞተ፥ በዛብሎንም ምድር ባለችው በኤሎም ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
verses.fr: Après lui, Abdon, fils d''Hillel, le Pirathonite, fut juge en Israël.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ የጲርዓቶናዊው የሂሌል ልጅ ዓብዶን በእስራኤል ላይ ፈራጅ ሆነ።

verses.en: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
verses.fr: Il eut quarante fils et trente petits-fils, qui montaient sur soixante dix ânons. Il fut juge en Israël pendant huit ans;
verses.am: አርባም ልጆች ሠላሳም የልጅ ልጆች ነበሩት፤ በሰባም አህያ ግልገሎች ላይ ይቀመጡ ነበር። በእስራኤልም ላይ ስምንት ዓመት ፈረደ።

verses.en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
verses.fr: puis Abdon, fils d''Hillel, le Pirathonite, mourut, et fut enterré à Pirathon, dans le pays d''Ephraïm, sur la montagne des Amalécites.
verses.am: የጲርዓቶናዊውም የሂሌል ልጅ ዓብዶን ሞተ፥ በተራራማውም በአማሌቃውያን ምድር በኤፍሬም ባለችው በጲርዓቶን ተቀበረ። a

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent encore ce qui déplaît à l''Eternel; et l''Eternel les livra entre les mains des Philistins, pendant quarante ans.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንደ ገና ክፉ ሥራ ሠሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ አርባ ዓመት አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.
verses.fr: Il y avait un homme de Tsorea, de la famille des Danites, et qui s''appelait Manoach. Sa femme était stérile, et n''enfantait pas.
verses.am: ከዳን ወገን የሆነ ማኑሄ የሚባል አንድ የጾርዓ ሰው ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም መካን ነበረች፥ ልጅም አልወለደችም።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
verses.fr: Un ange de l''Eternel apparut à la femme, et lui dit: Voici, tu es stérile, et tu n''as point d''enfants; tu deviendras enceinte, et tu enfanteras un fils.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ለሴቲቱ ተገልጦ እንዲህ አላት። እነሆ፥ አንቺ መካን ነሽ፥ ልጅም አልወለድሽም፤ ነገር ግን ትፀንሻለሽ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ትወልጃለሽ።
